body:
Let me share a story
| | |
---
Friend, I wanted to reach out this evening because we have an important deadline coming up. I'm about to ask you to help me hit my $300,000 weekly fundraising goal. But first, I want to tell you a story about doughnuts — and how they're going to help us save our Senate majority.
**[(If you're short on time and ready to retire Rick Scott this fall, you can chip in here to help me make up this fundraising gap and flip Florida blue.)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84522436/471785062/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1196-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGE3N2Y3MDgtZDAwYy1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ANzITUqSfWq-M_zlh90AU5kf7WPyZxg_g4xs9L0SEMo=)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84522437/471785063/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1196-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGE3N2Y3MDgtZDAwYy1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ANzITUqSfWq-M_zlh90AU5kf7WPyZxg_g4xs9L0SEMo=)
When I was 14, my family came to America to seek a better life. We arrived here with big dreams for the future. But those early days were hard. I remember my mom working back-to-back double shifts and _still_ struggling to afford rent for our small, one room apartment.
**So, after I turned 15, I got a job working the early morning shift at a local doughnut shop.** It was just a minimum wage job, but the small checks I brought home gave my family room to breathe. Finally, after a lot of hard work, the possibilities that we could only dream of before became reality.
We were able to move out of that one room apartment, and I got a scholarship to an incredible college. Eventually, I found a career path where I could give back to the communities and country that gave me so much. That call to service took me to places I had never even dreamed of before. **I became the first South American immigrant to serve in Congress, and now, I'm running for the United States Senate.**
**Making doughnuts in the morning before homeroom brought me all the way to Congress. ****I've seen time and time again how small acts have the power to create big, transformative change._And that's exactly how we're going to win this campaign in November._**

* **Ending the School-to-Prison Pipeline** : Removing police from our schools and restoring safety and trust.

* **Canceling Student Debt** : Freeing a generation from the shackles of debilitating loans.

* **Promoting Fair Admissions** : Reinstating the fair consideration of race, ethnicity, and class in school admissions.

* **Teaching Full History** : Abolishing laws that restrict the accurate teaching of our nation’s factual history.

* **Increasing Funding** : Boosting support for HBCUs and Tribal Colleges and Universities.

| **About Dr. Cornel West****
** Dr. West, affectionately known to many as Brother West, is the Dietrich Bonhoeffer Professor of Philosophy and Christian Practice at Union Theological Seminary. Dr. West is the former University Professor at Harvard University, Professor Emeritus at Princeton University and the first Black person to receive a Ph.D. In Philosophy from Princeton University. He has written 20 books and he is best known for his classics, Race Matters and Democracy Matters, and for his memoir, Brother West: Living and Loving Out Loud. He will deliver the historic Gifford lectures at the University of Edinburgh in Scotland in Spring 2024. Dr. West enters the 2024 Presidential contest at a time in which he describes a national crisis of moral bankruptcy and spiritual obscenity driven by a derelict duopoly of both major parties that equally places profits over people and the planet. West asserts that running as an Independent candidate affords him the opportunity and duty to deliver policy prescriptions incorporated by and for the people, instead of political parties beholden to corporations and special interest groups who feel no solidarity with poor and working-class people of all races, gender identities, and age groups. The Cornel West Campaign to empower poor and working people everywhere stands at a pivotal moment in history, committed to being a true campaign for people around the globe. Our aim is and will always be to unite in solidarity with movements of truth and justice, who seek a choice beyond empire, white supremacy, capitalism, patriarchy, and the confines of the corporate-dominated two-party system.
---
| **About Dr. Melina Abdullah****
**
Dr. Melina Abdullah is a Professor of Pan-African Studies at California State University, Los Angeles, where she has also served as Department Chair. A respected scholar and dedicated activist, Dr. Abdullah is deeply involved in organized labor and social justice movements, holding roles such as the Chair of the Council for Racial and Social Justice with the California Faculty Association’s Los Angeles Chapter. She has been a lifelong union organizer and a delegate to the County Federation of Labor, melding her academic expertise with grassroots activism to champion causes such as the "Cops Off Campus" campaign and the establishment of Ethnic Studies in educational curricula. A founding organizer of Black Lives Matter, Dr. Abdullah continues to lead the Los Angeles chapter and serves as Director of Black Lives Matter Grassroots, driving local and national initiatives that aim to dismantle systemic racism. Her leadership has been pivotal in various campaigns for justice and equity, including #BlackWomenAreDivine and #EndPoliceAssociations. Dr. Abdullah's commitment to social change is also evident through her role in media, where she produces and hosts "Move the Crowd" on 90.7FM KPFK, furthering public political education. Beyond her professional and activist roles, Dr. Abdullah is a devoted mother and a champion of community engagement and empowerment. Raised in Oakland, California, by a family of union workers, she embodies the values instilled by her ancestors and strives to pass on a legacy of resilience and advocacy to her three children and her community in Los Angeles’ Crenshaw District. Her extensive contributions to social justice have earned her numerous accolades, including the Koreatown Immigrant Workers Alliance “Champion of Change” Award and the Martin Luther King, Jr. Award from Loyola Marymount University.

## **Ending Birthright Citizenship for Children of Illegal Aliens**
[](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-eihfhk-yuddtktydi-y/) DALLAS, TX, May 7th, 2024 -- Today, the Huffines Liberty Foundation is releasing its latest report, _[Ending Birthright Citizenship for Children of Illegal Aliens](https://news.huffinesliberty.com/t/t-l-eihfhk-yuddtktydi-j/)_._This paper surveys what birthright citizenship is, the birth and history of birthright citizenship in America, options for ending birthright citizenship for children of illegals, and the burden birthright citizenship puts on taxpayers._ Prior to 1868, no one argued that children born in America to noncitizens automatically became American citizens; however, with the ratification of the Fourteenth Amendment, that changed. In 1898, the U.S. Supreme Court decided that a child born of permanent residents who legally entered the United States was a citizen. Today, this has led to the practice of granting citizenship to the children born of illegal aliens in America.However, there is much debate about whether granting citizenship to children of illegal aliens is required by the Fourteenth Amendment. Certainly, this question has never been addressed by the Supreme Court.Given the possibility that the Fourteenth Amendment does not grant citizenship to everyone who is born here, it is possible that universal birthright citizenship could be ended, or at least restricted, without an amendment to the U.S. Constitution. One way to do this is through the passage of legislation by Congress under its powers in Article I, Section 8 of the Constitution. Another way is through the adoption of an executive order by the president of the United States. Perhaps the only certainty in this debate is that if one of these methods is tried, it will wind up in court.The primary reason that universal birthright citizenship is a major issue today is because of the uncontrolled mass illegal immigration that is overwhelming the country today. While taking legal steps to end universal birthright citizenship should be pursued, the best way to restrict it is for America to regain control of its national borders. Our mission is to advance the cause of **liberty** , **prosperity** , and **virtue** in the State of Texas by educating and equipping citizens so they may hold their elected officials accountable and better informed to tackle the toughest challenges.###

name: Andrew Hughes
subject: Should Dr. Ben Carson Be Canceled?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| |
---
| | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

Dr. Carson asked me to reach out to Americans who want what’s best for our country, to help him take a stand against “cancel culture.” It’s tearing our country apart and needs to be stopped.

This is something he has experienced firsthand.

As you may have heard, this past November the Detroit School Board voted to change the name of the Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine. Why? Because the School Board was mad that Dr. Carson was part of the Trump Administration!

These educational leaders – who should be acting as role models for our kids – instead decided to create a huge political spectacle by “canceling” Dr. Carson and trying to erase his amazing achievements as a doctor, as a leader, and as a citizen. It’s really outrageous.

Dr. Carson is disappointed by this – not because he wants any glory but because it sets a bad example ... for the kids at this school, and for the entire country.

“Cancel culture” tells young people and all Americans that you shouldn’t listen to those with whom you disagree and try to find common ground; you should just stigmatize them and erase them.

The Left probably expected Dr. Carson to lash out at the Detroit School Board and his political opponents – hurl some insults, call people names, keep the fight going.

But instead, Dr. Carson said to our team here at the American Cornerstone Institute (ACI):

_“What if we use this as an opportunity to rally people across the country to speak out against cancel culture? To show America that we have a better path forward for our country than hate and division?”_

And that’s exactly what we’re doing. It’s why Dr. Carson launched ACI in the first place – to lead the way for what’s best for our country.

And we’ve created a way for you to stand with Dr. Carson and make your voice heard. Just click the link below; it will take you to our **National Statement Against Cancel Culture** that you can review and then co-sign.

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.)

Dr. Carson is getting asked about the Detroit school incident quite a bit, and when he answers he wants to speak for Americans who are heartbroken by what cancel culture is doing to our country – who want this divisiveness and vitriol to end! I think you’re just such an American.

And when you and thousands of concerned citizens like you sign this Statement, Dr. Carson will be able to keep speaking from the heart against cancel culture – knowing that he’s broadcasting a message that is important to his fellow Americans.

He can say ... “Enough is enough! I’m fed up with cancel culture, and so are folks everywhere who love America and want what’s best for the country.”

If that’s a message you want Dr. Carson to share on your behalf, please take a moment now to be part of ACI’s **National Statement Against Cancel Culture**. Here’s the link again for you:

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/cancel-culture-pledge](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.-tw)

Amid all the divisiveness and polarization that has been injected into our policy debates, Dr. Carson is proud of the work ACI is doing to encourage Americans to come together despite our differences and find ways to take on the challenges that face our country.

I hope you’ll join Dr. Carson in this important work. Thank you!

Sincerely,

Andrew D. Hughes
Executive Director & CEO
American Cornerstone Institute

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we’re doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

| |

---
| | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zitrl43nets3ijr5jdqk5gtitthm2sus3jglifko_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm8pb1c9h2bs "Byron Donalds")
---

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsajgq361jpngi7u35nnn0lkpaa6mg1pt1hfbtk8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm8pb1c9h2bs "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

I'm perfectly okay with that. But it means if we want to WIN BIG, the burden falls on all of us to step up. _**[That's why I'm coming to you now - would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it's 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvlbqlb0ivv9kjdc5llbrhup5v8uc8j2at4mkn5g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm8pb1c9h2bs "That’s why I’m coming to you now – would you be willing to pitch in a few bucks to help kick start these efforts? Whether it’s 10 bucks or 100 bucks, I only ask that everyone pitches in SOMETHING.")**_

Look,

**I know it 's a lot to ask but I GUARANTEE it'll all be worth it when we expand our Conservative Majority, take back control of the Senate, and win the White House.**

I don't know about you but the thought of unified Republican control fires me up! If that doesn't convince you to want to help, I don't know what will! Are you in?
---

Before I go, I'll just say this:

The Democrat Party is spending more money - and spending it earlier - than we've ever seen before. They know they are LOSING on the issues.

That's why they're compensating by raising astronomical sums of money, plastering social media with Liberal propaganda, and unleashing the powers of our Federal Government to attack Conservatives.

**But make no mistake: there are a lot more of US than there are of THEM!_[So if every Conservative in America steps up, there is nothing we can't do. So will you do your part when we need you the most?](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zkojivd9ei5b89l6rou5dsrteph09sblgh6693ko_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm8pb1c9h2bs "So if every Conservative in America steps up, there is nothing we can’t do. So will you do your part when we need you the most?")_**

I hope you'll join us. I really do.

Thank you,
Byron Donalds

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zto043uifehqfrvv341b8ip4q640um2nr79idq2g_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm4ob7cph2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8e31bp2fb7p24abk79vs9iatcs0i2bb23l6sop0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm4ob7cph2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvmr7vq6hmu92ut3ntlisii8rhu4is5t8cvq6740_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm4ob7cph2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1ct3hctjk3vdcck675j7lrlqvc9a0bi4r4o4048_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm4ob7cph2bs)**

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: Before they're gone
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z64sk1eh67nkvpthvm8qic1u0ph3gf6a0q0k6qj0_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm2oj2clh2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmh6oo6r0p0sv1fmcqth2ouilq3gpkr13mm4ooo8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm2oj2clh2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zof3mkjtc5hmoogjtks34c78dkq53l2duqbtqkvg_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm2oj2clh2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College
P.S. The **“The Second World Wars”** DVD set is great as a homeschool curriculum or for independent study. Plus, it makes a perfect gift for anyone who wants to know more about the Second World War. **[Reserve your copy now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zr3rqiegrgodrdvfd2hba219fiou72uland0g6r8_rp22sh2s8i6ep35chhm2oj2clh2bs)**

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/M_mMBuUnTdjE5MYwf-U6fg~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. name: Kimberly Carris
subject: This November, It's Personal for Us
body:
Dear Peter,As I sit at my kitchen table watching the news, I feel drawn to write to you and ask you for your help. The most important election of our families' lifetimes is six months away and our District and our country are in dire need of leadership in Washington that listens to families. The anti-Israel protests across our nation on college campuses are horrific and scary to say the least. As a parent with a daughter away at college, I am worried about her safety and all of the students' safety in our nation. At different times in life, we are called to serve. Whether that be volunteering at a food bank, place of worship, retirement center, school, medical center, or helping a neighbor in need, whatever it may be, it ALL matters. **Giving back gives us all a sense of purpose**. Taking care of one another is what life's all about.My husband, Jim, has been called to serve. Deep in my heart, **I know that he is the leader we need right now in the Illinois' 10th District**. Jim running for US Congress was not an easy decision. Walking away from a gratifying professional career, taking time to campaign, and putting our family on the front line of scrutiny isn't easy. After much consideration, Jim and I feel strongly that right now is the time for him to do this. In doing so, as tough as this can be, we are teaching our kids to stand up for what they believe in and do what they think is right. **We believe that getting our nation back on the right track is worth fighting for**! With that said, I am asking you to kindly donate to my husband's campaign. **Every dollar matters in getting Jim's message out**. It costs money to run tv ads, radio ads, purchase signage, and send mailers. Please use the donate button below. If you prefer to send a check, please mail to:**Carris for Congress**
736 N Western Ave. #323
Lake Forest, IL 60045 [DONATE NOW!](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-r/) To those of you who have already donated to the campaign, **THANK YOU**! Team Carris appreciates all of the friends and family who have generously donated. Voters realize that if Jim wins, he will be voting on issues that will affect everyone in our district and many of which will have an impact on EVERYONE in the United States. If you and/or your kids would like to join me and my family to get involved in the campaign and help get our nation back on track, please click below. [GET INVOLVED AND VISIT OUR WEBSITE](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-y/) With sincere gratitude, _Kimberly Carris_ **Follow Jim's Campaign on Social Media** [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-j/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-t/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-i/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-l-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-d/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-fb-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-h/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-tw-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-k/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-li-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-u/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-eiukhtd-l-o) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail19.com/t/t-u-eiukhtd-tlidtddjku-b/)

## Trump Documents Case Indefinitely Delayed
A judge delayed former President Trump's classified documents case [indefinitely Tuesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOtCAURp8GOwwgKBYUf2M3f7ulUbiMd4Ng5M6YefuNW2_zNV9ycnK-HvNjwYT5-X_ZwVEs8-IJ3zAbbrnSs26CiwAKugacHKSRg-y1bjbnZWfX1SgR5ej1qnRnZR98F73wozW2QaeE0sIIK6zptWx7HbsoZexVlOMYgWkBAamc7XfBTBvE9ClvOFtf9ia5jeiorPvH1MTUdF1X6_Pq75Op6UYzNQlzz8DUROdrP7hPS60YEQIPxb92yFQ5nbgkfpRKR8kQOOYAETMSpE-70Z6a04XjwpSw9gPT4rkvmH4t6K8kPwEAAP__LiRinQ) due to possible mishandling of documents by prosecutors. The trial had been set to start on May 20th, but Judge Aileen Cannon said there were still a number of pre-trial issues before her. The ruling casts doubt on whether the trial will happen before the Nov. 5 election. Trump's team also argued that the Justice Department had filed some of the[ classified documents out of order](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9uwyAQgPGnwRsR4PMfBoYu3tK1o0XwYV-FwcLnVHn7Kp07_5ZP39d9vntKlNdPv6PjWGYfmJ44d3KUBmZoFhcRDbYNOj3oTg-6B2g2Z4bxMUDno4JxeNgR-w5taFsVQrQ2QkPOKAOqU6Maux70rYfYRq1jb6K2NqIAhQtxqbfvQpk3jOlVnlhvoexNchvzcYr2Q5hJmIk33CiltwkzVVyv5JlKFmYK5aosH5454SnMBD1Yq5UMPueSJeUFI2ViTC95lJOPkvGUXK_9OOXuq_Qy-bXIpYRrx8xvI5-EmZrqluOHUqKzHwSodff0l9Dwf69-AwAA__9RX2zb)[ ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOtCAURp8GOwwgKBYUf2M3f7ulUbiMd4Ng5M6YefuNW2_zNV9ycnK-HvNjwYT5-X_ZwVEs8-IJ3zAbbrnSs26CiwAKugacHKSRg-y1bjbnZWfX1SgR5ej1qnRnZR98F73wozW2QaeE0sIIK6zptWx7HbsoZexVlOMYgWkBAamc7XfBTBvE9ClvOFtf9ia5jeiorPvH1MTUdF1X6_Pq75Op6UYzNQlzz8DUROdrP7hPS60YEQIPxb92yFQ5nbgkfpRKR8kQOOYAETMSpE-70Z6a04XjwpSw9gPT4rkvmH4t6K8kPwEAAP__LiRinQ)when packing them in boxes, even though the prosecutors had told the judge they were all in the exact same order. The Justice Department admitted this week that there had been some misplacements within some boxes, but said it didn't affect the case.
## Medicare, Social Security See Gains
The "go-broke" dates for Medicare and Social Security [have been pushed back](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7hzBAjYuKF6TLq-90sKwm-wJ2xFsEuXvT7n6ytE0o_m6LJfIhffr_7hhEDqWmISfuLjBD2AX2-dAiICmx6An7fSkR2v7W_BOUZ7NqgHimDGmrLLzkAjXabJ56jmAAquc8sq70erTaMmQ1jQC6Xkm7KzCzHLU0_fBu9yQyvt4Yj2lY-tLuIncW2f-dXDu4BzvO77aR32gCqeCHZzbkTiWoWF6VJb3sGHmFCsOuAtLwQ13aYNUjO1R34NxEWZtoiHQ0ayKyCqC5H1aaU5r6mvI9xeXwm2cOquuW-Ty2yN_zfkJAAD__4mLZuU) thanks to an improving economy, according to the programs' annual trustees report. Medicare will now be able to pay full benefits through 2036, five years later than previously estimated. Social Security will be fully solvent until 2035, a year later than estimated. When the funds' reserves run out, they would only cover 80%-90% of benefits. Administrators warn that despite this week's positive news, the long-term trend may still require changes in [how the programs are funded ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFv8yAQgOFfgzcsOLCNBw_f4i3fElUdrTM-4mtwiIAkyr-v2rnzu7x6Pk_LCTny7fIfD5pqSAv6yk9aOukk2MU22xSIgExDkx50pwfdW9vs06hXcp1DOwQwgdCMwRkyPTpQxgA0PIECqzrllOt6q9veBhO0Dj0EPY6BhFW0cU25_Up8qzuF-E5Pyq1PRxOnvdZ7EeafgFnAjKu_0au0l_STBcwfZwHzizOda8pvAfNBG3vMJEvyjFEW8o_M9S3XnK4kN6xU5P1Rdtrkiv4qD8LyyCS1GsdBGWebPG33F8fIpR-EVZcDOf7e1L9ovgMAAP__w_hlQQ)and paid out to keep them solvent past the next 10-12 years.
## Ranking: Best States in America
U.S. News & World Report released its annual best states list, ranking Utah, New Hampshire, and Nebraska as the nation's top three states and Louisiana, New Mexico, and Mississippi as the bottom three states. [See rankings here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO4yAQQL8GOiLAA3YKimvc5dorLQ4GM7sYR_Yk0f79Kltv-fSKJ71_t-UWqVFf_8YNA5d9iYnpiYtTk7KwgMyhIFocJAYzGmdG4wFkDUPM2riE3pvBOdS5aMBhdBbNWLCApGC1Be30pCfnwVw8lKEYU7wt5notKEBjJt6Py8dOnSuW9rU_8bikfZMtVOb7KYY_ws7CzlyxUmtvJ-ycauwr9VXFDQ9KUdgZ-0Gpbtj5DfmRItPehZ3BwzSCVQ-OVfW4YVb_8WR1cmRU1FXHlzpi_6S-nsLO8gj5_qLW6PSjAL1ukX66kn8b9B0AAP__Uzlniw). States were [evaluated on their performance](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1urDAUhJ_G7oz8b1O4uA3d3jYlMssxODGwss8uyttHbJUi3TeaTxppPm7jLeaS9-V_3CBgOsZ4x_yC0TDPpB41nUMCkKAoBOGEEU5YrekahOjTFI2TKlmrdPSTccZPXkmjeT85moPkUnPDPffGatFZnVQSIlmZRN8nIJrDnPGo3eeRd1whle_jBbW7HxstYUV8NKL-ETkQOZzn2T3bDme7aiKHC4kcJmjIGkaEK8WK-V7e-GzsUliFArFBY79MVuP-lfel0Rrmx5lLyc06ovmyxVze-_jXGT8BAAD__1liYbA) in healthcare, education, natural environment, opportunity, economy, infrastructure, fiscal stability, and crime and corrections. Utah ranked among the top 20 in seven of the eight categories. The rankings also included a list of the [ten safest states ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFutDAQBOCnMR3IaxbjK1z8Dd39bUpkYPfYyOATdg7l7SOuSZNuRl8x0nzcx3uQKPvjf9jIF05jmIu8aOxqVxscsVo8ExlqK_LQQwc9WMRq9XMPc5indoIwWUa-uaUD1qFjdM5ZrMQbbVB32mnXWYTGIrcMwNYw3G5MCjUtUtLRfCbZy0ocv9OLjmZOWxX9Wsozq_afMoMyw3mezVfe6cwXKzNcUZlholzqXEKhq-UoC-U1vQl0nQP_ei17HTY6ZA7V4ZfnKTFKtr1C_diCxPdu-euEnwAAAP__GLVfFw)in the U.S., with New Hampshire, Maine, and Idaho as the top three.

The ruling casts doubt on whether the trial will happen before the Nov. 5 election. Trump's team also argued that the Justice Department had filed some of the packing them in boxes, even though the prosecutors had told the judge they were all in the exact same order. The Justice Department admitted this week that there had been some misplacements within some boxes, but said it didn't affect the case. Medicare, Social Security See Gains The "go-broke" dates for Medicare and Social Security thanks to an improving economy, according to the programs' annual trustees report. Medicare will now be able to pay full benefits through 2036, five years later than previously estimated. Social Security will be fully solvent until 2035, a year later than estimated. When the funds' reserves run out, they would only cover 80%-90% of benefits. Administrators warn that despite this week's positive news, the long-term trend may still require changes in paid out to keep them solvent past the next 10-12 years. subject: Combating Antisemitism
body:
Peter- Congress has taken a significant step in addressing the troubling rise of antisemitic incidents nationwide with the recent House passage of the bipartisan Antisemitism Awareness Act, a piece of legislation I am proud to co-sponsor.

This act requires the Department of Education to implement the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance’s working definition of antisemitism in enforcing federal anti-discrimination laws - codifying a Trump Executive Order.

Given the recent aggressive antisemitic protests on college campuses across the country, it is crucial that we ensure Jewish Americans are protected from hate and that perpetrators of antisemitism are held accountable.

Help us continue our fight. [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=link&utm_campaign=Combating+Antisemitism]

name: Hillsdale College via Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=676fb3ea249a4ad2819c17f3618396b4&_e=iOLhwm2BBJnVWspymOkZWJ3vyj_SLMKCADuFuzkBBZXFiyKUk4fQNh7XqTHcFj1uPIur6AC7MuPbOxBWH4--YbENi40bXJ4Y5-9xk9NrR6q6kTjzJ-ajgFTbej9qYTlp94738rwPuTl3KZgiijK5nQFSTYYutbxw7aFTtsQraLvJfLmIBmuWZOl5IqwuDB-5LHpBFbj-Z7ULKRbXLyDBZ79Ud6f3369M64CxNcow8vNS58pIJsB9ZeOpeuD01j3UnQ8f5Np_wwOuaEvMu43mKy-K7v1QzD7gyBaaaZOa3W-LLV00r1JM_A9mtlOjjqVCrX-WvjrR8rJecK5PGQsKqamCeYXBiqDP2va3CQQUXuZ4kjAB2OVrE7QeXZ2UkgNm-0YhYUrmnDi4j4JK2Gv61A%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=676fb3ea249a4ad2819c17f3618396b4&_e=iOLhwm2BBJnVWspymOkZWJ3vyj_SLMKCADuFuzkBBZXFiyKUk4fQNh7XqTHcFj1uPIur6AC7MuPbOxBWH4--YbENi40bXJ4Y5-9xk9NrR6q6kTjzJ-ajgFTbej9qYTlp94738rwPuTl3KZgiijK5nQFSTYYutbxw7aFTtsQraLvJfLmIBmuWZOl5IqwuDB-5LHpBFbj-Z7ULKRbXLyDBZ79Ud6f3369M64CxNcow8vNS58pIJsB9ZeOpeuD01j3U_f2KesDsWwcBU_r0LIlmEV2ME8e-sXaNmQWgP9OWGLcwrHWXaEVKbESd4WZjtflxs-MvaXsRfGmL3UPzMFN4LFqfKovMEK4iV6cxMNcwtFsTD_RUxRebAYpCFLnHoHYps9Jxsb34N26VcjPqeQgWFQ%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=676fb3ea249a4ad2819c17f3618396b4&_e=iOLhwm2BBJnVWspymOkZWJ3vyj_SLMKCADuFuzkBBZXFiyKUk4fQNh7XqTHcFj1uPIur6AC7MuPbOxBWH4--YbENi40bXJ4Y5-9xk9NrR6q6kTjzJ-ajgFTbej9qYTlp94738rwPuTl3KZgiijK5nQFSTYYutbxw7aFTtsQraLvJfLmIBmuWZOl5IqwuDB-5LHpBFbj-Z7ULKRbXLyDBZ79Ud6f3369M64CxNcow8vNS58pIJsB9ZeOpeuD01j3UKMEzZEXSwpPJVphVWR5I-F_qPocePJ9mIZrTAFbwqzCqVRtuSvHvfFDLMxmD3J7PtW_0ttJX91irSclGA8GY1XKUiEU8J_T9RYlgCmg1X-j8cfa3vXoJHQNokxZ3oW359LtfFC2Sc7ZFAfT822MTPA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

Reclaiming American Freedom
---
_PO Box 461 Fort Collins, CO 80522_

---

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=15fee8527e2b46c79e6af820cab8416b&_e=8VpQ2W-d9CSQZ3ykNh586LgH5_LUHs1sooNAuONhmOoolad-yKFp6_4uYW8ikH8sw8XBYR1AX_IMgnrGyx6j-kApo_ldN1pUKo4kscqjee21c_1fWG4lGU_yUEwvvvbNotYK_sGVed6I4AIGxaxI28Ryy-HE6jzTNrnxjqBiCyqZVwirOJZgadQkxwcc9K1hjHRSxVCRdmRudZo4N1Q9pdhl2cKtUgIsYfqDUXeuhdvdP8SQ-J890jketfNz-kTgOHMC_ekDwGFOPGt4vsmnEYU_BWtQcKUlccahWkHvJLWnoScy51cRAj6UL9h_euLMcS9qv62B87tG6AiblJrfO1EDR1joym_eBRGWfYzeFVXktsgF9C_AZQozNk8-Ja1uFIbsgTLCs6D6Wlchx-FqU-FKoZ8e7OXupdkR1TssRpek9jBv5SJ1nMS6cmjhgcukfACLfBYjCddUvEnrTwYqtg%3D%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=052b59bb3e92488f9c0363ab5a27d731&_e=B8n353HArxsEJhPBGw0wzxem0Xrb3-Isw4IrCMQlUQCrN3XSXsIxXgsYMZBY-taqaVrnzlHhSOEPbd5RcuvP8dF0S9xgf-OeSTdh6-4kSZmc1_XmaVtGVPdsdQBjl1PG67AkgheNmEGIccWuDWHxcxfQRHZS93dU9Hgha1Xug2trmepqQ_aJMB-Bq6Whuf1BseEN4oySjGJ5WB5_ltwgel_jTEx5naYRGnzpMfZQl72-W8UQxJ13fwnBXt6fDGDPqet4SJQwk4iKxU-ycr4tU1iiokVLUDXkDQLHMOan80tc_VUr0tQFGpLqJHDC0EgOoFozSYczOHZrUxTfvTzqM_24I-knsIRJZIGC6Z8Bo2jEy3SOncmKbvzHx_DiGsnigIV51JPLuDv1QmXuUCQrYhDJMPc5PsN2PTRy3vxNgNA%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. name: Lena Moffitt, Evergreen
subject: Welcome, Jade Begay and Evan Weber
body:
Evergreen welcomes two climate powerhouses to our board
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2533195/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Friend,
I'm honored and thrilled to share the news with you today that Evergreen has welcomed two exceptional climate leaders to our governing board: **Jade Begay and Evan Weber.**

**Evan Weber** is the co-founder and former political director of the Sunrise Movement, where he helped write and advance the Green New Deal, and where he currently serves as board chair. He is now the managing director and co-founder of Our Hawai'i, where he builds multiracial coalitions to fight for local working families, and a policy fellow at Elemental Excelerator, where he leverages the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) to expand renewable energy and electrify working-class and Native Hawaiian households.

**Here's what Evan had to say about joining Evergreen:** |
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2533196/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| **Jade Begay** , Tesuque Pueblo and Diné, has worked with Indigenous organizations and Tribes from the Arctic to the Amazon to advance Indigenous-led solutions and self-determination through advocacy campaigns, research, storytelling, and narrative strategies. She currently serves on the first-ever White House Environmental Justice Advisory Council and is a research fellow developing climate data on Native communities in the U.S., and building pathways for Indigenous communities and Tribes to take advantage of the climate and infrastructure opportunities available in the IRA and Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act (IIJA).

**Here's what Jade had to say about joining Evergreen:** |
[](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2533197/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| As we enter the most climate-critical election year of our lives, we're grateful to have leaders like Jade and Evan fighting alongside us.

[**Give now to support our continued work toward a more just and inclusive clean energy future.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2533198/87SdQ4wZ) |

| Onward, |

As a conscious musician who embraced politics after years of [organizing hip-hop artists and MCs around the country](https://substack.com/redirect/db0b24de-5b44-4a4b-9ab2-36626fd96028?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to occupy public space, it always excites me to see other artists step forward to speak truth to power.
The need grows only more urgent as institutions from the Pentagon to the Democratic Party, to [a disturbing swath of universities](https://substack.com/redirect/d783c9ab-5cf5-435b-b12f-af1bd5d4cc68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the country, join together to embrace [an authoritarian vision](https://substack.com/redirect/b0f8f348-a8a4-4ef3-b64a-54ca89614510?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that precludes meaningful dissent in a country that absurdly claims to lead "the free world."
Over the weekend, Macklemore released a new track addressing the genocide in Gaza that demands attention. This post includes his latest music video, analyzes some of its most poignant lyrics and imagery, and explores how it relates to well-established themes in international hip-hop decrying police violence. It also features the work of other artists from the United States to France and Palestine, and a song I wrote and co-produced nearly a decade ago connecting the dots between police violence in the United States and Israel's longstanding apartheid in Palestine.
_Help inform your friends!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=144429030&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ0NDI5MDMwLCJpYXQiOjE3MTUxNzAxOTIsImV4cCI6MTcxNzc2MjE5MiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.hdMOpw2xHACJ9BrJe8DOcxQEIxgpzqPCWRsO_X9b2_A)
### **Hip-hop 's most central theme**
Hip-hop was born as a medium of expression among urban youth alienated from a civilization that treated them like cannon fodder. Born in the era when [the CIA was running crack cocaine into U.S. cities](https://substack.com/redirect/406b2839-82a0-4e38-9a15-dc3ec21d524e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to fund its internationally illegal terrorism in Latin America, hip-hop offered an array of artists a vehicle to observe the hypocrisy and brutality of a country with no commitments to its stated principles.
State violence, and its impacts on communities, were among the most consistent themes of early hip-hop. While tracks like "[Fuck the Police](https://substack.com/redirect/3b3616c4-4f57-4c1a-a401-bddff3e59b06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" by N.W.A. and "[Cop Killer](https://substack.com/redirect/092e940d-b8f1-4edd-be0f-4f68d008edb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" by Ice-T forcefully addressed police violence, others like "[Officer](https://substack.com/redirect/1972ba9c-b53f-4e49-b0cd-776c1b7bb469?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" by Pharcyde explored the same issues with a tongue-in-cheek tone employing humor.
### **A medium of global resistance**
Predictably, the art form attracted the interests of young people in other countries confronted by similarly arbitrary state violence, and political systems that turned deaf ears to their struggles.
In France, MCs of African descent pioneered [a new wave of hip-hop](https://substack.com/redirect/d984f6e2-44d9-40db-acb3-4cdc374460b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the 1990s, led by the iconic MC Solaar. His song "[La vie est belle](https://substack.com/redirect/c72590ee-31ae-4ec9-ad31-3912b75457be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" includes the following lyrics ([translated](https://substack.com/redirect/0d7831ef-de41-483e-9afe-2a300d487719?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) into English from the original French):
> I read in the papers that I'm in the Axis of Evil
> I read between the lines and understand they want me dead
> So I lock the door so I can be calm.
> It's the war outside, I think it's coming towards me
> Despite the demos, he who lives will see it*
> I put sandbags in my living-room
> Bastards want to shoot me
Another legion of voices emerged from Palestine, reflecting in both English and Arabic on life under apartheid. Their music helped explain how the Israeli occupation of the West Bank and Gaza represented a long-standing genocide whose escalation many Americans have only begun to recognize in the past year.
[MC Abdul](https://substack.com/redirect/c4220b6a-6955-45fd-a1b2-047b633c5a2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is one of them. While any number of voices might seem to rival his, he stands well apart from most of his contemporaries by virtue of his remarkable prescience and precociousness. When he released "Shouting at the Wall" in 2021, [he was just 12 years old](https://substack.com/redirect/252505ce-5a21-4e87-9a14-54874982bfd5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8e5cceca-134a-4fc4-a307-081670254e57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..9JhmFeOY0CMs2OqRWthhnszX4vOij5gm9luA2WauyZA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=144429030)
### **What solidarity looks like**
Macklemore's latest track, "Hinds Hall," is significant for many reasons.
As a white American artist who has not himself been subjected to the experience of the Palestinians, his song represents a crucial message of international lyrical solidarity. Macklemore is also an independent artist, uncensored by corporate record contracts that have limited the expression of most other artists with similarly vast audiences.
"Hinds Hall" riffs on many themes, including the [brutal repression of student activists](https://substack.com/redirect/d783c9ab-5cf5-435b-b12f-af1bd5d4cc68?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by authorities across the United States, the cowardice of a political system that remains [dedicated to genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/cb40a133-1368-4889-a3ca-84991ec0bba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite sustained and escalating [global outrage](https://substack.com/redirect/87be0a49-b7e7-414d-ae49-b1d811702755?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the complicity of figures including [politicians and journalists](https://substack.com/redirect/289c8bae-6ef9-4296-909a-ddbd9a2be87f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) unwilling to challenge the ignorance that enables American & Israeli belligerence and disregard for human rights.
Both countries have [flatly refused](https://substack.com/redirect/a4bd57e6-b497-4e79-8d11-8d510647d46a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to comply with international law, making cultural resistance by conscious artists all the more critical. Macklemore's [powerfully expansive lyrics](https://substack.com/redirect/d283b313-5569-4ef0-b274-789e686aaa46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) find further expression in the remarkable imagery compiled in his music video.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1b464d13-de6f-4e11-8da8-0d790714f218?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
To whatever extent a picture conveys a thousand words, "Hinds Hall" represents an entire book. It explains that the Israeli state has long relied on apartheid, as well as the role of the United States in enabling Israel's ongoing, internationally criminal genocide across Gaza.
My favorite lines in the song are where Macklemore addresses [President Biden](https://substack.com/redirect/60123f2f-8fa6-424f-a2c2-1d23a91a110f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) directly, noting how he has pissed away his presidency, laying bare the [farce of the 2024 election](https://substack.com/redirect/f8fa77ac-42a5-48d1-9cfc-80d168f8ea77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Destroyin' every college in Gaza and every mosque
> Pushin' everyone into Rafah and droppin' bombs
> The blood is on your hands, Biden, we can see it all
> And fuck no, I'm not voting for you in the fall.
### **Can you hear me now?**
In 2016, I co-produced [a song that I wrote during the 2014 Ferguson uprising](https://substack.com/redirect/0c7cc2b2-441f-4369-8bc1-4f408fa91058?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) connecting police violence in the United States to Israel's longstanding violence against Palestinian civilians. "Ferguson to Jerusalem" focuses on many of the same themes that Macklemore explored more recently, from the history of [the Nakba](https://substack.com/redirect/531805d8-7758-41f8-89df-ee678d9c5018?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (which western news outlets consistently overlook when reporting on the Middle East) to the cruel & senseless conflation of anti-Zionism and anti-semitism that Israeli apologists use to smear their critics.
In addition to "[Ferguson to Jerusalem](https://substack.com/redirect/9845de00-b4f1-49c1-82ed-804c714f7937?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," and "[NSA vs USA](https://substack.com/redirect/ef66172c-db58-4d21-af49-0ba91abf108b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," I wrote & recorded a third song, "Legacy of Ashes," examining the criminal history of the CIA. I hope, with enough support, to eventually release all three songs as an EP.
One hopes that they will be less relevant by that point.
But don't hold your breath.

| Dear Peter,
[Time's Up TikTok](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R-XS5u_ZbOzfqoXfs6Dvb1kSC0cHgNLG_qX6NieEGwGOAIDywjxUWN4xFkIOWWHy3r4kdFw1hhwMCXK7YmMu2s8o-kadDHw5xEH-IoKIFaPoH2SgI6BmND6c2pKkWmk9Z1LSKnS9NxnR3Ht7NH-FFhNGt5i-ulaW&c=XiK3V-KJWqZUROWqAucJSBvNEmu-RVlkgW2Osr8kYSG1kPZ_6a0-CQ==&ch=ydUihi6k_fqJCgsrkUHtKxhZrHgOnKgikSPmbmbp-3MQOnu36wRcNQ==) was proud to play a role in helping pass the TikTok ban that was signed by President Joe Biden into law on April 24th.
But the fight is not over. The fight over TikTok brought to bear the most clear example we have seen of the Chinese Communist Party working to buy influence through powerful lobbying firms. In fact, there were numerous reports that the Chinese Embassy sent diplomats to meet with Congressional offices during the weeks leading up to the vote.
This is why I encourage everyone to read the [2024 Annual United States Commission on International Religious Freedom](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R-XS5u_ZbOzfqoXfs6Dvb1kSC0cHgNLG_qX6NieEGwGOAIDywjxUWMYmkTqsg5UbCSHZBB4y4LBKmb6CTdb6MnoC8m6zrNFLj5KhpqKCGk1R2rz6EezPgTfckzgs9HB9u6KYokfmbdlM5j4_MVI4Dk1rI4ymttESa7kJWmSYryvEIafHxadnvM_MkLf1JIyTjmd4sM22_LKJk-a1v8TZVE91dlHpN6Mpno2CLUhcGFI=&c=XiK3V-KJWqZUROWqAucJSBvNEmu-RVlkgW2Osr8kYSG1kPZ_6a0-CQ==&ch=ydUihi6k_fqJCgsrkUHtKxhZrHgOnKgikSPmbmbp-3MQOnu36wRcNQ==), specifically after the China section where ALL NINE commissioners in bipartisan fashion call to ban lobbying for the Communist Chinese Government.
They stated, "It is imperative to ban lobbying for the Chinese government, its state-affiliated commercial entities, and their interests while the government continues its egregious acts of religious persecution. These harsh actions impact every faith group in China with leaders of the Catholic Church and Protestant house churches imprisoned and even "disappeared."
Communist China is committing cultural genocide as it devastates Tibet where Buddhist monks die in prison. Their actions of physical genocide ravages Uyghur Muslims, where millions are sent to detention camps and Uyghur children are taken from their parents. Organs are harvested from Falun Gong and Uyghurs, some while still alive, and in Hong Kong, the Chinese government represses freedom loving Christians, including 92-year-old Cardinal Zen. China not only persecutes their own citizens but now it is pushing to spread communist influence worldwide. China supports Iran, which provided training and weapons for the attacks on Israel by Hamas and they supply arms to Hezbollah and the Houthis.
China aids Russia in its war on Ukraine and supports North Korea, one of the world's worst religious persecutors. And they are spreading their influence in the Americas. China supports both Nicaragua and Cuba where Christians are being aggressively persecuted.
Concerns are rising daily over China threatening to attack Taiwan, which many experts believe may lead to direct U.S. involvement and the loss of American military lives.
Amidst all of this, the words of 18th-century British parliamentarian William Wilberforce about the evils of the slave trade come to mind: "You may choose to look the other way, but you can never say again that you do not know."
The U.S. Congress and the American people cannot look the other way. For the good of our country and religious freedom worldwide, we are asking Congress to ban lobbying for the Chinese government and its interests.
Our goals:

* We are encouraging all Human Rights organizations to push for a Communist China lobbying ban when meeting with Congressional offices.

* We are asking individuals, like you, to call their Members of Congress ([Senator](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R-XS5u_ZbOzfqoXfs6Dvb1kSC0cHgNLG_qX6NieEGwGOAIDywjxUWMYmkTqsg5Ubpnrk-ImnU3Y0YdYVCz9iG2uJ9tqEr3QZwzpLA7zLZRYfaVcgchL9tyuPxgk20ogshqNfTTgd5ZsgOqCEYToNeTWBxWz6n-vmU_OFrlI2BEEhqC8dUHRHTl-dZpX4IdBo&c=XiK3V-KJWqZUROWqAucJSBvNEmu-RVlkgW2Osr8kYSG1kPZ_6a0-CQ==&ch=ydUihi6k_fqJCgsrkUHtKxhZrHgOnKgikSPmbmbp-3MQOnu36wRcNQ==) and [House Representative](https://tijrkiebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R-XS5u_ZbOzfqoXfs6Dvb1kSC0cHgNLG_qX6NieEGwGOAIDywjxUWMYmkTqsg5UbEjkY0HiCePEBdkgSJCWyxyY8YBACpCIqslajk6xX_3QSfPTZBm-eYJk_c0nR16cVwmPuLwK_1eJBg0jBOfs5TgM3Mcofv1-iNlTp2-KVtvGC9vnDJOpiscxSNV4jvYKSeMmgNdUkKbk=&c=XiK3V-KJWqZUROWqAucJSBvNEmu-RVlkgW2Osr8kYSG1kPZ_6a0-CQ==&ch=ydUihi6k_fqJCgsrkUHtKxhZrHgOnKgikSPmbmbp-3MQOnu36wRcNQ==)) to support a ban on lobbying for China.

Together, Trump and Rogers will do whatever they need to do -- and spend whatever they need to spend — in order to turn Michigan red.
We’re not going to let that happen.

Friends-
We’re closing out our issue spotlight with something we’ve talked about a lot: A Prescription Drug Affordability Board.
We fought hard this year to make meaningful progress on legislation to establish a Prescription Drug Affordability Board, but the bill was not signed into law. The Prescription Drug Affordability Board would have created an independent review board with the authority to evaluate medication pricing and set payment limits for consumers. The board would consist of health and medical experts and would use data-based and research-driven methods for evaluating prescription prices. We believe that we can lower the cost of living if we lower the cost of medicine, and a PDAB would do exactly that.
We were lucky to have stories from across the Commonwealth to show legislators during the General Assembly session. We had supporters willing to give remarks at press conferences, testify in support of the bill, and write opinion editorials supporting the board.
As an organizer, it’s a privilege for me to be able to share constituent stories with legislators. In any healthy representative democracy the connection between citizens and legislators is so vital - they need to be listening to the communities they're representing and hearing what folks need. But people are so busy - with work, family life, volunteering - it's difficult for them to step away from their lives to go to Richmond and make their concerns heard. Being the conduit in between people and their representatives is so rewarding because we can amplify their stories and share their experiences with legislators who need to hear them. Using personal stories to be the advocate for folks who are too busy or too sick to step into that role and advocate for themselves is a true honor.
We were largely successful in progressing the PDAB bill because of the experiences we were trusted to share with legislators. Now we are working to ensure we can replicate that success in 2025, and stories are a vital part of that.
If you have experience with the high cost of prescription medicine, we’d love to hear from you!
Share your story [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1corcX24sU8SGyHsLsdf0sOYMn0IUnWer5EUKDjaPTcrszw/viewform?usp=sf_link]
Thank you for using your voice

An unjust system is when four Supreme Court Justices nominated by Presidents who lost the popular vote, confirmed by a Senate who represent 40 million fewer Americans than the other party, strip rights the vast majority of Americans loudly support, while secretly (and openly) taking bribes from billionaires because they know they face zero accountability. Those same SCOTUS justices currently weigh whether a President of the United States has unlimited immunity--as if that should ever even have been a question to consider.
And yet, critics still claim it's wrong to demand expansion of the Supreme Court. Beyond the obvious and systemic deterioration of our rights, there are at least three reasons to expand the Court. **So, Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3082e664-959e-4140-84a2-d73d5d26972c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Before diving into those three (excellent) reasons, please answer the below poll. I'll ask you again at the end to see if you changed your mind.
| | POLL
---
Should we expand the Supreme Court to at least 13?
| [Yes](https://substack..nu3Tynp3oXvLXOlnw3togRJRdZCLFAkVo8zQIdl2VPo?)
---
[No](https://substack.._--b1dgkGhcXfwM7BPOFDt9PFqZO-WsdEgIAcog5h-c?)
[Unsure](https://substack..3xFhB8PRfObfa-lwXZbeWj8kRm-_ZCEfW74mIpvLqPM?)
Let's quickly recap just some the rights lost under this right wing Supreme Court of the United States ("SCOTUS"). At a minimum, Americans have LOST protections to:
•clean water
•voting rights
•reproductive health
•wrongful incarceration
•religion/state separation
•safety from gun violence
•4th amendment protections
•5th amendment protections
•anti-discrimination for being Queer
•racial justice in education and the work place
•economic justice for students suffering under predatory loans
And that's just a snapshot, but you get the idea on how dire the situation really is.
Elected Democrats who don't have the courage to demand we expand the court are severely underestimating the extremism of MAGA Republicans. Especially with Trump promising to establish a dictatorship, we do not have time to waste. Democrats must abolish the filibuster, expand the court, or we won't have a democracy left to save. Here are the core reasons why we must expand the court.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..LrigUd-k2Gnn5BMj6r5lGEd0hacl5i4EPPUyzIgr-8w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144294656)
**First** , expanding the Court aligns with historical precedent. As documented by the Supreme Court [itself](https://substack.com/redirect/973be753-3e1f-4c4e-826e-83aef20d377b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The number of Justices on the Supreme Court changed six times before settling at the present total of nine in 1869.
As many changes as our nation went through from March 4, 1789 (the date SCOTUS was established) to 1869 (the year of the last SCOTUS change in number of justices), it surely has gone through as many or more significant changes since then--clearly justifying further expansion. Likewise, one reason we arrived at nine justices in 1869 is our nation then had nine federal districts. Now, the United States has 13 federal districts. Precedent mandates that we remain consistent and expand to at least 13 Supreme Court seats. In other words, _not_ expanding SCOTUS to at least 13 is the actual contradiction to SCOTUS precedent.
**Second** , expanding the Court aligns with American population and demographic considerations. For example, in 1869 the U.S. population was approximately 38 million people, and we had nine SCOTUS seats, i.e. one for every 4.2 million people. In 2024 the U.S. population is approximately 335 million people, and we have nine SCOTUS seats, i.e. one for every 37.2 million people. Each SCOTUS justice today essentially accounts for the entire nation in 1869.
Expanding the Court will better ensure the will of the people is heard and represented. We are supposed to be a government by, of, and for the people. That cannot be lip service. It must be action. And in addition to better accounting for population differences, we must ensure SCOTUS accounts for demographic differences. Here's what I mean. Of the 116 SCOTUS Justices to date, their demographics break down as follows:
•108 white men
•4 white women
•2 Black men
•1 Latina woman
•1 Black woman
So in other words, white men, while only ~30% of the US population, represent 94% of the Supreme Court. Meanwhile, the rest of America at ~70% of the US population, represents just 6% of the Supreme Court. SCOTUS is supposed to represent the American people. It is not meant to be a racially or gender exclusive club. The solution is clear. Congress should expand SCOTUS to begin to ensure more accurate representation of _all_ Americans.
But, critics protest, "that's packing the court, and that's wrong!" I recall after the passing of Justice RBG, a MAGA voter objected exactly that point to me, complaining, "Democrats just want to pack the Court."
I responded (at the time in 2020), "Sure, let's talk about packing the court. Let's talk about how Republicans have won the popular vote only 1 of last 7 Presidential elections but have nominated 14 of last 19 SCOTUS picks. Let's talk about how Mitch McConnell denied President Obama's appointments of _an unprecedented 110 Federal judges_ , _and_ a SCOTUS appointment. Those 110 appointments were then appointed by President Trump with conservative judges, and the SCOTUS pick denied to Obama was given to Trump. And now, going back on their own rule to not appoint SCOTUS justices in an election year, the GOP wants to appoint a justice in an election year (which they successfully did with Justice Barrett). You cannot accuse Democrats of a hypothetical event that never happened while ignoring the actual court packing done by Republicans."
Which brings me back to my earlier point, that Republicans will absolutely break any rule, violate any ethical standard, and avoid any accountability to the law, if it means it gets them more power. And we know this because this is what they've done to pack the courts and secure a supermajority 6-3 conservative Court. And hence, my third point on why we need to expand SCOTUS.
Ethics.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..LrigUd-k2Gnn5BMj6r5lGEd0hacl5i4EPPUyzIgr-8w?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=144294656)
**Third** , SCOTUS desperately needs meaningful ethics reform to regain its legitimacy, and that just won't happen with the current SCOTUS. A [recent Gallup poll shows](https://substack.com/redirect/eddc95d5-3961-4e19-8a20-88760dcfda59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that while the Supreme Court enjoyed a remarkable 80% trust rating in the late 90s, it is now at a historical low of just 49%.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/644514fa-9b6f-4faa-96ba-c815d295023c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And this is not by accident. Repeated reporting shows that numerous billionaires [lavished millions in undisclosed gifts on Justice Thomas](https://substack.com/redirect/68cc98c1-8c64-4e5a-8831-03470d931ed1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He disclosed none of them. And it doesn't by any stretch stop with Justice Thomas. Justice Alito has repeatedly ruled on cases in favor of corporations like Exxon, while he held stock in Exxon. Justices Kavanaugh, Barrett, Alito, and Thomas all committed to respecting Roe as settled law, and then lied and voted to repeal Roe. Americans are outraged, feel unheard, and lied to.
This corruption is the exact reason why Supreme Court justices are required to disclose gifts and financial benefits. And the fact that there's no accountability for this overt corruption, is another reason why we need to expand the court to at least 13 and bring balance back to the Supreme Court.
In conclusion, while we are quickly running out of time, it is not too late--yet. Democrats can still stand united to abolish the filibuster, vote to expand the Court, and add at least four more seats to make it a 13 member Supreme Court. Doing so will restore alignment with historical precedent, restore alignment with America's population and demographic realities, and restore alignment with ethics and integrity that our Court is supposed to uphold. And if nothing else, [polling shows](https://substack.com/redirect/b71f94ea-8635-4d89-838b-6fc16a2d57eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that an astounding 66% of Democrats wants to expand the court. Elected Democrats should finally listen.
Failure to act risks not just a continued degradation of our fundamental rights as Americans, but a dissolution of our democracy itself. Therefore, we must expand the Court to save our democracy--while we still have a democracy to save.

Of the 116 SCOTUS Justices to date, their demographics break down as follows: •108 white men •4 white women •2 Black men •1 Latina woman •1 Black woman So in other words, white men, while only ~30% of the US population, represent 94% of the Supreme Court. Meanwhile, the rest of America at ~70% of the US population, represents just 6% of the Supreme Court. SCOTUS is supposed to represent the American people. It is not meant to be a racially or gender exclusive club. The solution is clear. Congress should expand SCOTUS to begin to ensure more accurate representation of all Americans. But, critics protest, "that's packing the court, and that's wrong!" I recall after the passing of Justice RBG, a MAGA voter objected exactly that point to me, complaining, "Democrats just want to pack the Court." I responded (at the time in 2020), "Sure, let's talk about packing the court. Let's talk about how Republicans have won the popular vote only 1 of last 7 Presidential elections but have nominated 14 of last 19 SCOTUS picks. Let's talk about how Mitch McConnell denied President Obama's appointments of an unprecedented 110 Federal judges , and a SCOTUS appointment. Those 110 appointments were then appointed by President Trump with conservative judges, and the SCOTUS pick denied to Obama was given to Trump. And now, going back on their own rule to not appoint SCOTUS justices in an election year, the GOP wants to appoint a justice in an election year (which they successfully did with Justice Barrett). You cannot accuse Democrats of a hypothetical event that never happened while ignoring the actual court packing done by Republicans." Which brings me back to my earlier point, that Republicans will absolutely break any rule, violate any ethical standard, and avoid any accountability to the law, if it means it gets them more power. And we know this because this is what they've done to pack the courts and secure a supermajority 6-3 conservative Court. And hence, my third point on why we need to expand SCOTUS. Ethics. Third , SCOTUS desperately needs meaningful ethics reform to regain its legitimacy, and that just won't happen with the current SCOTUS. A that while the Supreme Court enjoyed a remarkable 80% trust rating in the late 90s, it is now at a historical low of just 49%. | | ---|---|--- And this is not by accident. Repeated reporting shows that numerous billionaires . He disclosed none of them. And it doesn't by any stretch stop with Justice Thomas. Justice Alito has repeatedly ruled on cases in favor of corporations like Exxon, while he held stock in Exxon. Justices Kavanaugh, Barrett, Alito, and Thomas all committed to respecting Roe as settled law, and then lied and voted to repeal Roe. Americans are outraged, feel unheard, and lied to. This corruption is the exact reason why Supreme Court justices are required to disclose gifts and financial benefits. And the fact that there's no accountability for this overt corruption, is another reason why we need to expand the court to at least 13 and bring balance back to the Supreme Court. In conclusion, while we are quickly running out of time, it is not too late--yet. Democrats can still stand united to abolish the filibuster, vote to expand the Court, and add at least four more seats to make it a 13 member Supreme Court. Doing so will restore alignment with historical precedent, restore alignment with America's population and demographic realities, and restore alignment with ethics and integrity that our Court is supposed to uphold. And if nothing else, that an astounding 66% of Democrats wants to expand the court. Elected Democrats should finally listen. Failure to act risks not just a continued degradation of our fundamental rights as Americans, but a dissolution of our democracy itself. Therefore, we must expand the Court to save our democracy--while we still have a democracy to save. | | POLL Asking a second time. Should we expand the Court to at least 13? | ? ? ? | | 1\. Voter Registration: OpportunitiesTo Change The Future
---
| | Great job to all who are putting in the effort for new voter registration—it's really making a difference! In Central and Eastern Washington, the number of newly registered voters in 2024 could make up 2-5% of the total voter turnout, possibly even reaching 12% when combined with 2023 registrations. Given the struggles with Democratic voting numbers, this new voter base is incredibly important.
---

# [Remove Judge Cannon from the Trump Case NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td53361d6-933f-4d64-a3bd-dbefb64d8970/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Aileen Cannon, the judge in the Trump documents case, has shown herself to be wildly biased and jaw-droppingly incompetent -- and now she has taken it to a whole new level by announcing that the case will be [delayed indefinitely](https://default.salsalabs.org/T274f9d9e-9bb2-4bbf-9b32-6a8f4b5eb28f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). [**She has to go. Add your name, and demand that Judge Cannon be removed NOW.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb9e2b992-e0db-4003-a5ee-fe55cfe7ffb9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Cannon, a Trump-appointee, has been bending over backwards to help Trump. She has delayed the trial repeatedly for no good reason, and with her latest step, she is trying to end it before it begins. This is arguably the most important of all the Trump cases, and we can't have it controlled by someone in Trump's back pocket. She needs to go, and the trial needs to proceed as soon as possible. [**Add your name, and demand that Judge Cannon be removed NOW.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T882d8f7b-e299-4197-8c5f-9c5a07e8bb48/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Bob Lorinser
subject: The bigger issue here
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF DR
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Untitled%20design.png]
In interviews, on the campaign trail, and on calls by my grand-dog Bentley's side, I'm often asked, "What's your #1 issue? What's your top priority?"
As a family doctor, the quick answer is, "Universal healthcare." But why stop there? The better answer is "You." You're my #1 priority. Allow me to explain.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Bentley%20and%20Bob.png]
My campaign relies on the generosity of grassroots donors like you to achieve our collective goals. Your contribution—no matter how small—helps us move rural America forward!
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately.
DONATE $20.24 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=20.24&refcode=express_lane_20.24]
ANOTHER AMOUNT [drbob.me/aboutbob]
As I journey through Michigan's 1st District, I'm often asked about my positions and policies. Let me tell you, these aren't just my issues — they're ours .
Family sustaining wages. Kitchen table economics. Healthcare. Education. Housing. Childcare. Infrastructure and connectivity. Addressing climate change and protecting our environment.
These are not just talking points. They're the issues that are the lifeblood of our communities. When we improve on them, children thrive, families come together, and lives improve.
These priorities are universal, too. With a decade of serving five diplomatic overseas tours in 13+ countries in Asia, the Middle East, and Africa, nearly 35 years working as a Yooper physician, and traveling to almost 80 countries throughout my life, I've seen firsthand that these issues transcend borders. They unite us in our shared humanity and common aspirations.
Now, through my travels across all 36 counties of the 1st District, I've learned that despite our differences, our goals remain the same. We all seek prosperity, security, and a better future for ourselves and our children.
So, let's come together, not as individuals, but as a collective force for positive change. That is why I want need you in my corner; and you can rest assured I will be in yours.
Thank you for your generosity, loyalty, and support.
Onward,
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

**Listen up, friend!**

Sen. Jacky Rosen’s critical battleground race in Nevada was just downgraded from “Lean Democrat” to “Toss Up” by _The Cook Political Report_. This race is going to be one of the closest in the country, so here's what I'm dropping in to tell you:
