subject: [SIGN ON] Demand Congress take action to protect veterans
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Our veterans have dedicated themselves to protecting us and serving our nation. Now, it’s up to us to protect them.
#

_We’d like to let you know that the email below discusses suicide. If this is not something you’d like to read about today, please click away._
_If you or someone you love is struggling, please know that you are not alone. Please call the free and confidential national Suicide & Crisis Lifeline by dialing 988 or access help through their website at 988lifeline.org._
* * *
Friends -
Republicans in Congress say they care about veterans. And they blame all gun violence on mental health. But this year, with help from the gun lobby, they forced a dangerous new provision into the federal budget that makes it more likely veterans suffering from severe mental illness will die by suicide.
The provision is called Section 413. The new law puts our veterans at risk by blocking the Department of Veterans Affairs from reporting individuals deemed in crisis and at risk of suicide to the background check system.
This new law breaks 30 years of precedent and will lead to more deaths. We cannot let it stand.
[**Will you add your name today to demand Congress gets rid of Section 413 in the next appropriations bill?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/may24-protect-vets-pet/?source=em240508-1-30&refcode2=8057.3935704.kLEn5C&akid=8057%2E3935704%2EkLEn5C)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/may24-protect-vets-pet/?source=em240508-1-30&refcode2=8057.3935704.kLEn5C&akid=8057%2E3935704%2EkLEn5C)**
More than 6,500 veterans die by suicide each year, and they account for roughly one in five firearm suicides in the United States. Veterans are more likely to die by suicide than a soldier is to die on the battlefield.
Our veterans have dedicated themselves to protecting us and serving our nation. Now, it’s up to us to protect them.
[**So please, can we count on you to join us in calling on Congress to protect our veterans by dropping Section 413?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/may24-protect-vets-pet/?source=em240508-1-30&refcode2=8057.3935704.kLEn5C&akid=8057%2E3935704%2EkLEn5C)

Thank you for using your voice. It matters.
\- Team GIFFORDS

| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T77c707c3-2a46-4150-bb64-2c9911248411/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| | | Hey, Peter, thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important. You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place. Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an even greater and more long-term threat \- hopelessness. When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work. I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better. We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them. For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business. The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. [Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tae2da54f-31ce-4f29-a605-aa971aa26ee8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. [Click here if you think you can commit to a $25 monthly donation (or something like that).](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5d0c0cb3-e8f4-4096-bd5b-5417600bc5cf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). [Click here to just give a one time donation of whatever you can afford.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T676ed4d0-bcf0-4eac-b5fd-88541eb383a0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today. \- David Hogg

But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them. For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business. The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan: Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures. Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win. And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN. Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media. Hello
Friend,
Many of
us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. But
have you ever wondered where these amazing stories took place?
In our
fast-paced society, the average American travels about 30 miles a
day. As a result, it can be hard to picture the ministry of
Christ as he walked from town to town and village to village
healing the sick, raising the dead, and giving sight to the
blind.
Jesus
didn't zoom around on the expressway, he walked an average of
about three miles-per-hour, slow enough to minister to everyone
His father put in His path.
To help
you better understand Jesus' area of ministry and the
world-altering impact it had, I created The Jesus Map. It traces
the life and ministry of Jesus Christ, including 52 key events
from His birth in Bethlehem to His ascension on the Mount of
Olives
This
unique reference tool will let you see where he fed the 5,000,
walked on water, and was tempted by Satan. As you walk with
Christ and the Apostles down those dusty Israeli roads, you will
better understand the questions people asked Him and the needs he
confronted.

I pray it
will also inspire you with ways God wants to use you in your area
of influence. Many times, we only need to slow down enough to see
what God has in mind.
Here's
your link to get the map and begin your journey of discovery:
https://ptv.org/nna/the-jesus-map
Let's
walk together along the path of Jesus Christ.

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

name: Eric Hansen, candidate for U.S. Senate
subject: Save Money. Live Better.
body:
It's not just slogan... | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/24536f8f4674/im-running-for-us-senate-14179059?e=dbd1068b05)
---
Hi there - It’s Eric.
To me, “**Save Money. Live Better.** ” is so much more than just a company slogan. It’s how I plan to serve Delaware in the United State Senate.
Let me explain.
I spent the bulk of my career in the private sector at Walmart, and I’m proud of my time there. **My team and I saved the American people $25 billion because of our commitment to offer consumers everyday household items at lower prices. We never lost sight of that goal: Cut prices on things people need so they can live better lives.**
It was a simple idea, but it also took a lot of hard work, problem-solving, and collaboration. We could not have done it without the help and support of others.That’s the mentality I’ll take with me to Washington.
My goal is to help every Delawarean live a better life. It doesn't matter how old you are, where you come from, or what political party you align with. I want to help improve lives. More often than not, that means streamlining government and cutting wasteful spending so we can put money BACK in the hands of the people.
[Donate to Change Delaware! ](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=e138c8b6a6&e=dbd1068b05)
The reality is that career politicians just don’t get it. You can’t expect the people that created the problems to fix the problems. It’s going to take an outsider with private-sector experience to straighten out the mess in Washington DC. I know I’m up for that task, but I need your help to get there.
[**Will you take a leap of faith and send a political outsider to the U.S. Senate this November? I could really use your help and support.**](https://voteerichansen.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=507adf5d727e502cde205c852&id=f350390f1a&e=dbd1068b05)
Thank you!

body:
Ryan Mackenzie for U.S. Congress

Friends,

Since the primary, we have been full steam ahead in our mission to retire radical Susan Wild. It’s my privilege to represent you in this fight as your Republican nominee, and I take this duty very seriously. Susan Wild is in lockstep with the failed policies that have left us with a wide-open border, high inflation, out-of-control spending, and chaos on our streets.

It is time we elect someone who will put working families first by lowering the costs of everyday living, protecting our jobs, helping small businesses grow our economy, and fighting for our seniors.

#TeamMackenzie is growing and I hope you will join me in this fight as well!

We are thankful to announce the full support of all four Republican County Committees as we all unite in the fight against Susan Wild.

Here are a couple of highlights from the campaign this week:
* NEW ENDORSEMENTS
* INTERNS NEEDED
* WILD’S BORDER FAILURE

As always, if you need to get in contact with my campaign, please feel free to reach out at (484) 347-8777.

All the Best,

-Ryan Mackenzie

ENDORSEMENTS

#TeamMackenzie continues to grow. Here are a few of our new endorsements....

Speaker Mike Johnson

“I’m proud to endorse Ryan Mackenzie because he has a proven record of standing up for working families, taxpayers, and the safety of our communities. If we want to secure our border and get inflation under control, Lehigh Valley families deserve a Representative who will listen, do the work, and bring common sense to Congress, not just partisan politics. Ryan has done that in Harrisburg, and that's what he’ll do in Washington.”

- Speaker Mike Johnson

Fmr. Congressman Lou Barrletta

Greetings!
As we approach the 2024 election, our team will place an increasing focus on highlighting lawmakers running for office who have been champions for the American family.

Last night, Congressman Banks won the Republican primary to become the next Senator from Indiana!

clean_body: | | | Peter, Do you remember that feeling we all felt the day after Donald Trump was elected president in 2016? Do you remember walking around in disbelief and fear of what was to come, and how those fears were realized time and time again over the next four years? Or how divisive and hate-filled his rhetoric was then, and how it has only gotten worse now? Donald Trump is a bully, Peter. Pure and simple. Right now, Trump and MAGA Republicans across the country are trying to bring our country backward. They’re pushing measures that would limit health care for the LGBTQ+ community, erode protections for same-sex couples, and more. Measures that serve only one purpose: to spread hate and fear. History teaches us that democracies don’t disappear overnight. They disappear slowly. Subtly. Silently. A book ban. A court decision. A “Don’t Say Gay” law. An extreme political party determined to attack the most vulnerable among us. We have to fight like hell. Today, tomorrow, and all the days after. Until the polls close on Nov 5. Until Joe and Kamala have won another term. Until all the people in all the places can live freely surrounded by love. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Your contribution to the Biden-Harris campaign is more than just a donation. It is a statement. A statement that you stand against Donald Trump, his harmful rhetoric, and the MAGA extremism that seeks to undo all of our hard-won progress. This team has shown that we are so much stronger when we come together than any of the forces that seek to divide us. I hope you’re just as motivated as I am to keep up the fight. Jill Jill Biden

clean_body: | The good news just keeps coming, team! Young voters took action, and the Biden-Harris Administration delivered: Since President Biden took office, over $160 billion in student loan debt has been wiped away. And just last week, 317,000 Americans who had been scammed by the Art Institutes had $6 billion worth of student loan debt erased. This is an amazing milestone, but our work is far from over. Once implemented, this new wave of debt relief will impact 10% of student loan borrowers. But what about the other 90%? An estimated 38.9 million people will still have significant student loan debt. Young voters across the country are advocating for policies that establish higher education as a public right and not a privilege reserved for the wealthy. | President Biden has delivered on student debt relief because young voters turned out in droves in 2020 — and we’re going to do it again this November. body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Healthcare costs in America are out of control, forcing people to make an impossible choice between forgoing treatment or racking up medical debt. The consequences are devastating.

40% of Americans report [https://www.kff.org/report-section/kff-health-care-debt-survey-main-findings/] carrying medical debt. It’s the leading cause of bankruptcy for middle—and working-class Americans, even those with health insurance.

25% of Americans say they have skipped [https://www.kff.org/health-costs/issue-brief/americans-challenges-with-health-care-costs/#:~:text=The%20cost%20of%20health%20care,care%20because%20of%20the%20cost.] health care due to costs. An estimated 68,000 people die [https://www.sanders.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/Fact-Sheet_Medicare-for-All-2023.pdf] a year because they lack access to health care.

There is no reason people should carry medical debt in the world’s wealthiest country. It’s time for Congress to wipe the slate clean and pass the Medical Debt Cancelation Act, legislation Bernie Sanders and I introduced that would end the burden of punishing medical bills once and for all.

The Medical Debt Cancelation Act will:
✅ Cancel all existing medical debt.
✅ Wipe medical debt from all credit reports.
✅ Limit the accrual of future medical debt.

Sign the petition: Demand that Congress deliver freedom from medical debt for millions of Americans. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/medical-debt-petition?contactdata=QjddaQndQ+oLEZG1Fe+v9j38ShwykK1MdfvtjninFFQxerTi04O79Z6+T5dQ3Ljpt/qyTmbamkJwkHnB9g8kxg9vfhTCBFx/F4PlcN5glpLk7NAPgyQgd5Sca2X5LHaMbxbuafDThfPb53ZXq2wI2A==]

Healthcare is a right, not a privilege. Nobody should have to go into debt and face financial ruin just for getting sick or injured.

Tell Congress: Cancel medical debt. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/medical-debt-petition?contactdata=QjddaQndQ+oLEZG1Fe+v9j38ShwykK1MdfvtjninFFQxerTi04O79Z6+T5dQ3Ljpt/qyTmbamkJwkHnB9g8kxg9vfhTCBFx/F4PlcN5glpLk7NAPgyQgd5Sca2X5LHaMbxbuafDThfPb53ZXq2wI2A==]

In solidarity,
Ro

This evening EMILYs List will host our annual We Are EMILY gala in Washington, D.C. It's an opportunity to celebrate our community of candidates and supporters, and we look forward to it every year.

But as I get ready for tonight's program, I find myself thinking about the night before We Are EMILY 2022, when everything changed.

That was the night of the U.S. Supreme Court leak that confirmed the Court was planning to overturn _Roe v. Wade_. We Are EMILY proceeded as scheduled the next day, and suffice it to say: The electricity among attendees was palpable. The standout moment of the evening came when Vice President Kamala Harris issued a powerful question from our stage that captured the rage and determination in the room. She asked, **"How DARE they?"** [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84558752/471896737/-120062714?sourceid=1053619&refcode=WTEFEQ16_20240508_JMWAEkick_PL&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NDMxNGQ0Yy01NTBkLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D8a-aZ6VYMyWTPE9hesMmsnXwo_y5agLggw6fGfo-6k=) I'm writing to you today, Peter, because I hope you remember how you felt when you found out _Roe_ would be overturned. body:
Our children, grandchildren, and future generations need us.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84560051/471900140/1328794144?refcode=ea.a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEwZThjNWNmLTU2MGQtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5phaZ8SHL7Y15D242a_jsHw9Q7pmJz4L3jVzOxPaIHE=&emci=de179cbb-a40c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=4823105)
---
I just can’t get this number out of my head: **$500,000.** I came across a new chilling report that revealed _that's_ how much the climate crisis will cost a typical child born in 2024 during their lifetime. **And without swift governmental action, the cost per person could balloon to as much as $1 million!** Here’s how we could end up here: housing and energy costs will increase exponentially due to more frequent severe weather; food prices will skyrocket as the agricultural industry contends with new climate realities; taxes will need to go up to cover spiraling costs in healthcare and infrastructure repair; and personal earnings will shrink because of reduced labor hours and health risks, particularly for those in outdoor careers. Yet, amidst these bleak forecasts, there's a ray of hope. The same ICF study showing these daunting costs also tells us something crucial — if we act fast to cut emissions, we can significantly ease these financial burdens. It suggests that kids born this year could pocket an extra $300,000 if we swiftly tackle the climate crisis. **We need to follow the science.** That means putting a halt to ALL new fossil fuel projects; dramatically reducing our carbon footprint by switching to clean energy like wind and solar; making sure frontline workers and communities get a fair deal; and investing in climate-resilient infrastructure. I’ll be honest. When I read this report, I thought about my grandkids. This is not the future I want for them — and if there's something I can do to make the world better for them, **I will do it.** That’s why I’m so committed to our shared mission at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. Elections matter deeply. By electing leaders committed to bold climate actions like the ones I mentioned, we can mold a brighter future for the next generation. **[This leads me to one simple question: Will you join me and take our pledge to vote for climate champions this year? The time for change is now, and that change begins with us at the ballot box.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84560052/471900141/630285846?refcode=ea.a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEwZThjNWNmLTU2MGQtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5phaZ8SHL7Y15D242a_jsHw9Q7pmJz4L3jVzOxPaIHE=&emci=de179cbb-a40c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=4823105)** | [**TAKE THE PLEDGE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84560053/471900142/630285846?refcode=ea.a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ms=ea.a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImEwZThjNWNmLTU2MGQtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5phaZ8SHL7Y15D242a_jsHw9Q7pmJz4L3jVzOxPaIHE=&emci=de179cbb-a40c-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=a0e8c5cf-560d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=4823105)

clean_body: Our children, grandchildren, and future generations need us. | I just can’t get this number out of my head: $500,000. I came across a new chilling report that revealed that's how much the climate crisis will cost a typical child born in 2024 during their lifetime. And without swift governmental action, the cost per person could balloon to as much as $1 million! Here’s how we could end up here: housing and energy costs will increase exponentially due to more frequent severe weather; food prices will skyrocket as the agricultural industry contends with new climate realities; taxes will need to go up to cover spiraling costs in healthcare and infrastructure repair; and personal earnings will shrink because of reduced labor hours and health risks, particularly for those in outdoor careers. Yet, amidst these bleak forecasts, there's a ray of hope. The same ICF study showing these daunting costs also tells us something crucial — if we act fast to cut emissions, we can significantly ease these financial burdens. It suggests that kids born this year could pocket an extra $300,000 if we swiftly tackle the climate crisis. We need to follow the science. That means putting a halt to ALL new fossil fuel projects; dramatically reducing our carbon footprint by switching to clean energy like wind and solar; making sure frontline workers and communities get a fair deal; and investing in climate-resilient infrastructure. I’ll be honest. When I read this report, I thought about my grandkids. This is not the future I want for them — and if there's something I can do to make the world better for them, I will do it. That’s why I’m so committed to our shared mission at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. Elections matter deeply. By electing leaders committed to bold climate actions like the ones I mentioned, we can mold a brighter future for the next generation. | Let’s fight like hell, together. When I think about all we’re living through right now, I think about what my grandmother saw, organizing in Selma, Alabama during the civil rights movement.

I think about what my mother saw when she joined the Air Force after college. She worked so hard and rose to the rank of Lieutenant Colonel.

The women in my family showed me the meaning of strength. They showed me what it means to serve a greater good, and what it means to fight for what you believe in.

That’s why I ran for the House of Delegates. I was proud to pass laws to increase support for military families and veterans, add more teachers to the classroom, and expand protections for child victims of sexual assault here in Virginia.

**But today, Congress is broken. And women like my mother and grandmother – and folks across our community – have worked too hard and lived too much history to watch everything we care about slip away.**

I’m running for Congress because Virginians deserve someone who will fight for what’s right, who knows how hard it is to make ends meet, and who won’t let Congress take away our freedom to make decisions about our own bodies.

Peter,

Justice Democrats incumbent Rep. Cori Bush faces a serious threat in her
re-election campaign for Missouri’s 1st congressional district this year.

Her primary challenger is “raising money hand over fist,” but there’s one
problem — this so-called Democrat is raising big bucks... from Republicans.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240508-cb.hThuKb&refcode=em20240508-34697&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=34697%2E1203867%2Euf3q-R ]Rep. Cori Bush’s Democratic Challenger Is Raising Big Bucks — From
Republicans

We already knew Cori’s opponent, St. Louis prosecutor Wesley Bell, is
endorsed by the anti-Palestinian lobby group AIPAC, which is largely
funded by GOP millionaires and billionaires.

But HuffPost reports that Bell has accepted “more than $65,000 from donors
who also gave to one of Missouri’s two Republican senators... or Missouri
Secretary of State Jay Ashcroft, the leading Republican candidate for
governor.”

Two of those Republican megadonors are former Missouri House speaker
turned lobbyist Steven Tilley and billionaire hedge fund founder Daniel
Loeb. If Cori’s opponent is being fueled by wealthy, anti-abortion
conservatives who’ve poured millions into Republicans’ campaigns, why
should the people of St. Louis believe he’ll fight for them as a true
Democratic representative in Congress?

We can’t let a progressive champion and Squad member be replaced by
someone taking contributions from the same people trying to rip away our
rights and prioritize corporations over working families.

Thanks for anything you can give to power our work to re-elect Cori this

body:
|
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=6405%2E5257348%2EP7b7Ar)
Derek —
How a government treats its educators can tell you a lot about its values.
This Teacher Appreciation Week, it’s time to lay out the stakes in this election — and just how extreme MAGA Republicans are when it comes to educating our kids.
According to Mike Pompeo, the former Trump secretary of state and one-time presidential hopeful, **“the most dangerous person in the world”** isn’t an autocrat like Russia’s Vladimir Putin or China’s Xi Jinping — it’s American Federation of Teachers President Randi Weingarten.
This absurd claim would be laughable if it didn’t come from such a high-ranking government official.
Suffice it to say, I don’t see teachers or the labor leaders fighting for better wages and benefits, and better learning environments for their students, as _“dangerous.”_ **They are essential.**
From my very first days as an elected official, I’ve fought to put teachers first. As a California state senator in Sacramento, I helped pass legislation to secure cost-of-living increases for teacher pensions and updated textbooks in California’s K-12 public schools. In Congress, I helped deliver millions in grant funds for Early Head Start and youth development programs in our district.
But we can — and must — do more. From funding breakfast and lunch programs to provide every child with nutrition to lowering classroom sizes so each teacher can devote more attention to each student, the Senate has a leading role to play.
**[In the Senate, I’m going to do everything in my power to fight for teachers and the students they serve, from preschool to college. Add your name to my petition if you’re with me in the fight to support our educators and the students they serve._](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202405-teachers-appreciation-petition.IWwpIQ&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240508_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=6405%2E5257348%2EP7b7Ar)**
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-202405-teachers-appreciation-petition.IWwpIQ&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240508_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=6405%2E5257348%2EP7b7Ar)
---
I’m fortunate to have had so many amazing teachers in my life who inspired me to get into public service. Every child in our country deserves that enriching experience in the classroom.
Thanks for joining me in speaking up.
— Adam

body:
| | | | PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM JOHN DEATON SOUTHERN BORDER UPDATE
---
Peter,
I just got back from Yuma, Arizona where I visited the Southern Border.
As a young Marine, I served at the Marine Air Station not far from there, so I had to see the crisis firsthand.
---
[](https://scqeb6gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h7y6KyKu2KepJCkJktOiAFTFcAtTFuNY06DwKjMybQfTSxO0mjSJ-4D60lF2G68PpkSNRJpK3lBICi54CzwLXaUTTiWsMe7myqfnBbWcww4Qn5PaRTl8Sz1YuwuhiAVNxFSiB9M2pWViLrU8JACjLzKUf7exize_sAzFNuWN-MVJXDdihuBQHaGR_VDd8CdwhZLzpHtD8pXL-9pTZgBZxvgen567MZD2evybdnq1NugJFmLvyo_bpiQI3xMUjmPXRz6dMi_E6uW7YPP9-E_gqKfTvurHYRaDwO4IoS0QUTmt-J7AYlpQ5Q==&c=qzkQAPA1X4yUzoIrC1eYd9FZSFFyF38BnWsVzte64UE6kmw0EetOOg==&ch=6tpoSy3iIucbE09dDo2xAkLKH9YT1UUKmq6V8klQXBO7xjoTjsrXdg==)

| Seeing this humanitarian crisis first hand opened my eyes, Peter.
Massachusetts grapples with the struggles of drug addiction, as Chinese fentanyl floods our country.
Our veterans and our most vulnerable residents are losing the amenities they rely on while costing our taxpayers billions of dollars. Our healthcare system and social service agencies are breaking under the weight of this crisis.
Politicians like Elizabeth Warren have failed Massachusetts and the American people by neglecting this crisis for way too long.
In the Senate, I'll fight to secure our border and restore common sense to Washington D.C. I'll support our border patrol, and law enforcement to keep our nation and Massachusetts' communities safe.

Hello,
In 2022, no one gave my husband Adam Frisch a chance against Lauren Boebert.
Everywhere you looked, the political pundits were calling Colorado’s 3rd congressional district “Safe Republican” or “Solid R.”
Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84568123/471922613/1610638071?refcode=em20240508am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=c4a1aa94-600d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGExYWE5NC02MDBkLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RKEQTEOncbDXF_UP1Mz4K14rLoolJwyczWfh9Uxsw9o=)

Friend,

As Trump sits in a courtroom for his criminal trial, the “veepstakes” are fully underway. The shortlist for vice president includes some of the GOP's most embarrassing disappointments: Tim Scott, Marco Rubio, and JD Vance. All of these men turned their backs on conservative principles and sold their souls to Donald Trump.

At the top of that list is Kristi Noem, the Governor of South Dakota. She’s been all over the news for her new book, in which she outlines what she believes is a flattering story: shooting and killing her 14-month-old puppy.

As crazy as that is, it’s not why I think she is so dangerous. She has been constantly spreading lies about the 2020 election results to try and suck up to the former president. **Anyone willing to sell out democracy to get a job should never be anywhere near the Oval Office.** Kristi Noem should never be in office again—let alone the White House. And it’s yet another reason why we’re doing **everything** we can to defeat Trump this November.
Sarah Longwell

| | Fellow Conservative, It’s tough to be a kid today. And, if you have children, I’m sure you know how frightening it is to be a parent. When I was growing up, I spent most of my free time outside the home – playing with kids in the neighborhood and hanging out with friends at school. _Sadly, social media has destroyed that world._ Many kids today spend hours mindlessly scrolling on their phones, cut off from the social activities vital to their development. **This has led to a disturbing mental health crisis among minors. And I firmly believe we need to address the dangers of children using social media.**** ** That’s why I’m partnering with Senator Brian Schatz to introduce the **Kids Off Social Media Act** to severely limit minors’ use of social media sites. Senator Schatz is a committed liberal, and we don’t agree on much. But we’re both determined to prevent social media companies from ruining our kids’ childhood. **_I’d like to know what you think about this, Fellow Conservative. _**[**_Please take this quick_**** _Protect Kids from Social Media Survey_**](http://trk.tedcruz.-qQH9cy3B9VR36v7FYPA)** _to let me know your opinion: _**

| | Please Join Judge Jerry Lynch in Whitefish

Whitefish Community Leaders Support Judge Jerry Lynch to be Montana’s Next Chief Justice of the Montana Supreme Court

Tuesday, May 14, 2024 – 5-7pm
Montana Tap House
845 Wisconsin Ave unit C
Whitefish, Montana

Donations to Jerry Lynch campaign can be made by writing a personal check and mailing to Lynch for Montana, PO Box 1116, Helena, Montana 59624 or donate online at www.lynchformontana.com. The current legal limit per person is $790 for the Primary Election (June 4, 2024) and $790 for the General Election (November 5, 2024), although any amount that fits your family budget is appreciated and will help empower the grassroots campaign.

A historic election will take place next year. After 16 years and the recent retirement announcement of current Chief Justice Mike McGrath, Montana voters will elect a new Chief Justice to lead the Montana Supreme Court and Montana’s judicial branch of government in the 2024 election.

Judge Jerry Lynch is running a campaign to serve as Montana’s next Chief Justice of the Montana Supreme Court.

Judge Lynch was in public service for more than 28 years as a Federal Magistrate Judge in the Montana District of the United States District Court (2006-2019) and as a law clerk for the honorable Paul Hatfield, then District Judge on the Federal United States District Court for the District of Montana. He worked for ten years as an attorney in private practice in Montana and served on the Montana Board of Public Education and the Montana Board of Environmental Review.

He earned his undergraduate degree in biology from Carroll College in Helena and his law degree from The University of Montana Law School (1981). Judge Lynch earned his master’s degree from Montana State University, focused on zoology and genetics, including the genetic variability and divergence of Montana’s indigenous grayling fish population.

Judge Lynch and his wife of 48 years, Teri Darragh Lynch, have four children and 10 grandchildren. Learn more at www.lynchformontana.com.

We were thrilled when The Oregonian endorsed Tobias ... and the newspaper endorsements kept coming!
We’re thrilled to let you know that Tobias has also been endorsed by Willamette Week, Eugene Weekly, Yamhill County’s News-Register, and the Portland Mercury !
Oregon’s editorial boards are all recommending Tobias–can you please chip in to help us keep spreading the word?

When asked whether he would accept the results of the 2024 election, he REFUSED to give a straight answer even when asked multiple times. He then claimed that _NBC_ was an extension of the Democratic party! Listen, we’ve seen what happens when politicians claim that elections were stolen and refused to concede, and it led to immense chaos and multiple deaths on January 6th. Scott’s comments come on the tail of Trump baselessly saying that “Democrats get welfare to vote, and then they cheat on top of that.” [**We know that none of this is true and that there is no evidence of mass voter fraud or cheating in our elections. But this type of rhetoric is detrimental to our democracy, and we’re fighting hard to protect our right to vote through the**** _Freedom to Vote Act_****. If you’re ready to protect our democracy by expanding and protecting voting rights, please chip in $10 now and join us in the fight.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84574765/471938492/-1814496574?refcode=5-8-24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNS8xLzkwOTg3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVmMzM5Y2IyLTY5MGQtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=V6aTrU8tEx_AcPpPkTfQL8-50sSMBiiISJ_Z33Ahvhs=) We have proof Republicans will stop at nothing to suppress our right to vote, which is why we need to pass the _Freedom to Vote Act_ to protect this right at a federal level. The _FTVA_ will increase election security, minimize the impact of Big Money in our elections, and expand voter registration, all while maintaining secure elections. [**These baseless claims of cheating and stealing elections are just another voter suppression tactics that Republicans are using. The claims are not only untrue, they’re dangerous, and we saw that clearly on January 6th. The**** _Freedom to Vote Act_****will protect our right to vote, but we need you on board with us. Hi there, this is Congressman Dan Goldman from NY-10. I was lead majority counsel during the first Trump impeachment trial — and since then, I’ve borne the brunt of many MAGA attacks.
I can’t believe I’m saying this, friend, but**Marjorie Taylor Greene told me to ”shut the f*** up”.**
I’m past the point of being surprised by Marjorie Taylor Greene’s lack of decorum, but this might be a new low — _even for her._
During a House Oversight Committee hearing, Chairman Comer was yammering on about Republicans’ sham impeachment inquiry against President Biden. When I interjected, Marjorie Taylor Greene loudly told me to “shut up,” then moments later mouthed to me, “shut the f*** up.”
This is where today’s Republican Party stands, folks. Majorie Taylor Greene’s behavior is not only normalized within the Republican Party but _is often even applauded_. It’s deeply concerning that Republicans can’t engage in political discourse without resorting to childish behavior.
I’ve been vocal about House Republicans’ blatant abuse of power in pursuing a baseless impeachment against the president, and Republicans like Marjorie Taylor Greene don’t appreciate me calling out their investigation for what it is: a baseless sham investigation that was infiltrated by spies from both Russia and China.

subject: The team that will win in Arizona

body:
Friend, when I was first thinking about launching this campaign last year I had no idea what to expect.
I knew I had some supporters from my congressional campaigns that I could count on, but beyond that it was a shot in the dark.
One thing I knew for sure was that whether this was a 2-way race, a 3-way race, a 27-way race, whatever — I was going to need the support of a huge grassroots team behind me. Over the last year we’ve built that team, with close to 150,000 individual donors.
And now we know: Sinema’s out. This race is a head-to-head between me and Kari Lake. And we've got to expand out that grassroots team and build a coalition here in Arizona that can defeat her.
I believe that we can. But I can’t do it alone. So today, I’m asking you, very humbly, to make a donation to my campaign.
Please, split a $5 or $10 donation between Serve America and my campaign. Whatever you can afford can help us build the team that’s going to win in Arizona. Your support is critical to defeating Kari Lake and holding our Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
Thanks a lot for this. I really appreciate it.
Ruben

subject: The Washington Post is parroting right-wing talking points on Social Security
body:
A new Media Matters report shows The Washington Post’s outdated model of journalism isn’t working.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84578309/471950042/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNGZlNTEyMDItNmYwZC1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nVL4TauzVnYc8AQahmu7ZXGmaxX0sNVzT2wMg9fuenM=&emci=939e1afc-6e0d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=4fe51202-6f0d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
A new report from Media Matters found that _The Washington Post_ recently misled its readers with a ridiculous sky-is-falling take on social security.
In the article, _The Post_ repeated Republican talking points about Social Security running out of money and erroneously claimed that funding Social Security was increasingly the national debt.
**Perhaps most distressingly, in an election year, they falsely claimed that both President Biden and Donald Trump don’t have a plan for Social Security’s future. This is despite the fact that, later in the article, they mention President Biden’s actual plan to raise taxes on the wealthiest Americans to ensure Social Security’s solvency. **

name: Katie Porter
subject: All Members of Congress have a choice when it comes to this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
A lobbyist came up to me and said “Well, I guess you’re one of the new Members we’ll never see.” I asked him why. He said it was because I didn’t take corporate PAC money.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38857%2E3422442%2E8TQBO3)
Derek, it’s Katie Porter.
A few years ago I attended a reception for newly elected Members in DC. A lobbyist came up to me and said “Well, I guess you’re one of the new Members we’ll never see.” I asked him why. He said it was because I didn’t take corporate PAC money.
**Since that day, I’ve said clearly—if lobbyists want to meet with me, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks.**
As Members of the House, we are one vote of 435. That often means only a fraction of the bills we want to pass will ever become law. **But we all have a choice to make when it comes to corporate PAC money.** As Members of Congress, we’re privileged to be in positions of power, and we should use our power to stand up to the status quo and corporate special interests.
But unfortunately, this attitude isn’t the norm in Washington. Too many politicians are beholden to corporate PAC and lobbyist money and a system of legalized corruption. Our housing crisis, climate change, and rising prices are a direct result of this system, which puts corporate profits ahead of people.
**That’s why I started Truth to Power, an organization dedicated to supporting Democrats who reject corporate PAC money.** These candidates can only compete because of grassroots support, and so your donation helps us make all the difference. **[I hope you’ll consider joining me by giving a $5 contribution to Truth to Power today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240508?refcode=em20240508-38857&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38857_3422442_8TQBO3&akid=38857%2E3422442%2E8TQBO3)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240508?refcode=em20240508-38857&refcode2=38857_3422442_8TQBO3&akid=38857%2E3422442%2E8TQBO3)
Thanks for considering,
Katie Porter

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240508-38857&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38857_3422442_8TQBO3&akid=38857%2E3422442%2E8TQBO3)**

Peter, Watching the media to ensure they aren’t misrepresenting or outright lying about our campaign is like playing a game of whack-a-mole. The most recent example is the NY Times saying that the Green Party has failed to get on the ballot in New York **_while we are in the middle of gathering signatures_** to gain ballot access and the deadline is still three weeks away.
---
---
Furthermore, they say the “Green Party” won’t be on the ballot in Idaho, without mentioning that our campaign did gather the necessary signatures to get Jill on the ballot. The requisite signatures were approved by the counties and were submitted to the Idaho Secretary of State before the March 15th deadline. This is nothing new. Whether it’s through boldface falsehoods or lies of omission, outlets like the New York Times are showing, yet again, that they are nothing but mouthpieces for the political elites. What is true is that getting on the ballot in New York is a huge lift and we do need donations to make it happen. But if we get New York, we’ll be well on the way to ballot access in every state. **_So, Peter, can you help us send a BIG correction to the NY Times by getting our campaign for people, planet, and peace on the ballot in NY with your contribution today:_**

This much is clear: Raquel Terán is building the broad and diverse coalition we’ll need to win this competitive primary and lift up Democrats in November. However, there’s one thing we still need: As grateful as we are to earn the support of so many amazing leaders and organizations – it’s your endorsement that would make all the difference. [] Our grassroots campaign is powered by folks like you. That’s why we’d love if you became a Community Endorser for Raquel Terán! [] I ENDORSE RAQUEL [] We hope you’ll join us today, Peter. We can’t do this without you. Muchas gracias, Team Terán [] Raquel Terán is running to represent Arizona's 3rd Congressional District as the first Latina congresswoman from Arizona. For nearly 20 years, she's been fighting for higher wages for workers, healthcare for all, and better schools for our children. She's helped build broad and diverse coalitions that have beaten Republicans like Donald Trump, Joe Arpaio, and Kari Lake. Now she's ready to take the fight to Congress, but we'll need your support to win. Chip in today! name: Leaders We Deserve HQ
subject: We just announced our second round of endorsements
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
These folks are going to be fantastic representatives for young people in their respective state legislatures, but they need our support to win first.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240508-1&t=1&akid=664%2E587540%2EhnCUW0)
You don't want to miss this, Peter!
We just announced our second round of endorsements for the 2024 cycle on Monday, and we’re _super_ excited about all the awesome young leaders we’re going to help elect this November!
In case you missed it: We’re endorsing — immigrant rights advocate and first-generation American **Luis Mata** and abortion rights champion **Allie Phillips** in Tennessee, ER Nurse, abortion rights and public transit advocate **Molly Cook** in Texas, climate advocate **Nate Douglas** in Florida, non-profit leader and a former Captain in the NC National Guard **Dante Pittman** in North Carolina, and first-generation American, Rhodes Scholar and a leader in the fight to repeal Arizona’s abortion ban **Oscar De Los Santos** in Arizona.
They're going to be fantastic representatives for young people in their respective state legislatures, but they need our support to win first — **[so read more about them below, and then pitch in $5 now to help us get them elected!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240508-1?refcode=em20240508-1&amount=5&refcode2=664_587540_hnCUW0&akid=664%2E587540%2EhnCUW0)**
Thanks,
Leaders We Deserve HQ
\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: **David Hogg** [info@e.leaderswedeserve.com]
Date: Mon, May 6, 2024 at 3:05 PM
Subject: New endorsements just dropped →
To: Peter [dpwillis67@gmail.com]
When we announced our first slate of 2024 endorsements several weeks back, this team really rose to the occasion and showed massive support for our candidates.
I have every reason to believe that supporters like you will do the same thing for our brand-new slate of endorsements in competitive districts across the country.
**Without further ado, we're revealing our second round of 2024 candidates![(If you don't have the time to read more about them below, you can still donate $5 to support our work.)](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240508-1?refcode=em20240508-1&amount=5&refcode2=664_587540_hnCUW0&akid=664%2E587540%2EhnCUW0)**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240508-1?refcode=em20240508-1&amount=5&refcode2=664_587540_hnCUW0&akid=664%2E587540%2EhnCUW0)
**Luis Mata (TN HD-49 – Murfreesboro)**
Luis Mata is a lifelong community advocate who is running for the state legislature to build a stronger Tennessee. Raised by a single mother who immigrated to Tennessee from Mexico, he learned the values of hard work, resilience, and unity. If elected, he’d be the first and only Latino state legislator in Tennessee.
**Allie Phillips (TN HD-75 – Clarksville)**
Allie Phillips is a mom and Tennessee native who is running for office to make much-needed change in her community and her state. When she was 19 weeks pregnant, she learned that her unborn daughter was not compatible with life. Because of her state’s draconian abortion ban, she was forced to travel 900 miles to terminate the pregnancy. She is fighting for reproductive freedom to make sure no one else has to experience the same traumatic situation she did.
**Molly Cook (TX SD-15 – Houston)**
Molly Cook is a Democrat, an ER nurse, and a community organizer running for the Texas Senate because she has seen too many of her patients suffer preventable harm as a direct result of bad policy. She already won a special election for this seat, but needs our support to win a runoff and the general election. If elected, she will be the youngest – and most progressive – member of the Texas Senate.
**Nate Douglas (FL HD-37 – Orlando)**
Nate Douglas is a climate organizer and policy researcher running for the Florida Legislature because he was raised by his first-generation American parents to believe in fairness and freedom – and he has seen too many freedoms being stripped away in his state, from book bans to attacks on abortion rights and the LGBTQ+ community. If he wins, he’ll be the youngest legislator in Florida.
**Dante Pittman (NC HD-24 – Wilson)**
Dante Pittman is a community leader and member of the NC National Guard whose family has called North Carolina home for generations. He is running for the state legislature to make life easier for folks in eastern North Carolina by advocating for affordable housing, public education, and economic opportunity. This is going to be the most competitive legislative race in the state this year, and a win here could block a GOP supermajority.
**Oscar De Los Santos (AZ HD-11 – Phoenix)**
Oscar De Los Santos is an internationally-recognized leader and the incumbent in Arizona’s 11th legislative district. He is a proven fighter for working families, voting rights, fair wages for teachers, and equality for all Arizonans. In April, he helped reverse Arizona’s draconian 1864 abortion law and became a new target for the GOP. We’re going to help him defend this seat so he can keep making progress.
**[I am personally setting a $24,000 fundraising goal to build a strong foundation of support for all of our 2024 Leaders We Deserve candidates. If you’re ready to join our fight to elect these young, progressive leaders, pitch in $5 now.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240508-1?refcode=em20240508-1&amount=5&refcode2=664_587540_hnCUW0&akid=664%2E587540%2EhnCUW0)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240508-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240508-1-664&refcode2=664_587540_hnCUW0&akid=664%2E587540%2EhnCUW0)**
These candidates – and everyone we’re supporting in 2024 – are the leaders we deserve. We’ve already been on the ground – with Molly in Houston and Nate in Orlando – helping these inspiring young candidates build successful campaigns. Witnessing the enthusiasm for their bold new leadership has been so rewarding. I can’t wait to see the progress they make after we help them win these elections.
**We’re pouring everything we can into electing these young leaders all across the country.** We spent more than $100,000 to help elect Nadarius Clark in Virginia last year. We’re prepared to make _major investments_ for all of our candidates.
I am so inspired by and proud of all 12 of our endorsed candidates – and you can expect us to announce even more endorsements in the coming months. There are so many incredible young people rising up to run for office, but they need a strong bedrock of support to defy the odds, break down barriers, and win these races.
**[Reaching our $24,000 goal this week is absolutely vital – because it’s going to take a lot of resources to propel these campaigns to victory. Peter, pitch in $5 or whatever you can right now to elect the next generation of leaders!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240508-1?refcode=em20240508-1&amount=5&refcode2=664_587540_hnCUW0&akid=664%2E587540%2EhnCUW0)**
Thank you!!
David Hogg
Leaders We Deserve
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20240508-1&t=2&refcode2=664_587540_hnCUW0&akid=664%2E587540%2EhnCUW0)**

Friend,

Today, I am reaching out with an urgent call to action–one that will undoubtedly shift the balance of power in the Senate and give Republicans a fresh, strong voice in New Mexico.

Of course, I’m talking about my friend **Nella Domenici** , a true fighter running for Senate in New Mexico. Nella represents the very best of our values and is committed to service and delivering results for the people of the Land of Enchantment.

clean_body: | | Hi Peter, you see Sarah's email? This month's primary is crucial. It is only through your support that we are able to reach voters and help elect futre climate champions. With a donation of just $50, we can knock on 150 doors and talk to voters about OLCV-endorsed candidates. We need the right people in office to get to the just and equitable climate future we are all working towards. Sincerely, Gordon Robinson OLCV Engagement Organizer | Hi Peter, This May, with an election on the horizon, we hope your spring flowers won’t be the only thing blooming! This is a critical election year — and this month is especially important with the primary coming up soon. We need all hands on deck, and enough volunteers to knock on doors and get the message out about OLCV-endorsed candidates who will take bold action on climate. Leading up to an election, our staff and volunteers work hard to grow OLCV with your dollars. It’s not possible for us to expand our reach without you watering our gardens. We need to expand our reach now , because the more conversations we have and doors we knock on, the closer we are to electing climate champions who will help us fight for a just and equitable climate future in Oregon. Did you know that a gift of $50 is all it takes for OLCV to recruit one new volunteer? A donation of any amount is one that keeps giving back, because this new volunteer will then be trained to recruit 3 other new volunteers. All of these volunteers will then individually speak to 50 people about our endorsed candidates. So, if we can start 3,000 conversations with just $1,000 , that means 15,000 conservations with $5,000. what our garden could do with just enough water and support from all of you; imagine how many more voters we could reach if we meet our goal of $5k! Just like a garden, once we’ve planted the seed, helped it grow, this seed will then help plant other seeds that will grow, and on and on. all know how important elections are - especially this year’s - for electing the right candidates who care about environmental justice, share our values, and will fight for a safe and healthy future in Oregon.**** Sincerely, Sarah Kline OLCV Communications & Membership Coordinator | ---|--- | | Connect With Us: | | Contact Info: Oregon League of Conservation Voters 1110 SE Alder Suite 220 Portland, OR 97214 United States | ---|--- | If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. | ---|---

| Peter,

In politics, my commitment has always been clear: putting Virginians first. As the representative of Virginia’s Seventh District in Congress, I've strived to advocate for and address the needs of Virginians every day.

_**When I see a problem – I act.**_

When I first decided to run for Congress after the election of President Trump and attempts to dismantle the Affordable Care Act, I was motivated by my desire to help people and give our district the representation it deserved. I'm bringing that same commitment to my campaign for Governor of Virginia.

Every day, I am reminded of the importance of putting Virginians first, especially as we travel across the Commonwealth and hear from people on the issues that matter most to them in this upcoming election.

Together, I know we can expand economic opportunity for everyone, strengthen our schools, keep our communities safe, and protect the fundamental rights of all Virginians.

From hearing the concerns of Virginians to advocating for their needs, my commitment to bringing people together and solving our toughest challenges remains unwavering. Every day, I am reminded of the importance of putting Virginians first, especially as we travel across the Commonwealth and hear from people on the issues that matter most to them in this upcoming election. [Hiding your face](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=310da7e950054770bdd59d0223394d3d&_e=t0-6wOjwVfn-8jmJe3y2LDEhHsKjyuZhpIuwg4GJ1IYFUt1MzFN43XN7K70m-V6JHfji3TwPR6jSN1pgkQf8RxV1nLhtbzm2RPQZ89RUTaMIXNBJ_PcIhn2BsWjWybcOM7jvafgvZ4reDV8G5XnHNYm-_5cnDEDlgUpCXc099dJpQYwm8vhdZXA7EmIjTrjoIarBOyF8qghgfendFeZ-O77pIB5i6aVhpdZBn0Ls-_5XRn9KTUq-hUVWlWLy7Qs6EuqQnftZX2F1OWH6v9FoXg%3D%3D) does not make you untouchable, in fact, it makes you an even slimier scoundrel. Whether you’re in disguise while committing a crime or trying to threaten and intimidate folks exercising their constitutional rights or privileges, this bill will ensure some serious consequences. We're talking fines and/or prison time—up to 15 years of it. But that’s not all. | Government can be an engine of progress, helping residents in every ZIP code reach their full potential.

Hard-working families across MD-02 are struggling to afford their rent and mortgage payments due to decades of racially motivated redlining practices that separated our neighborhoods and financial barriers that push housing prices just out of reach for too many Americans.

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=dda3e2faee8443dbafcc75b9b3c9ed92&_e=F4MCra-x4hHpF4I8Crw6TmYrYr--d7Dvt7fHuXdRjM8W949HUhTpsn9MHoz3LRKWsWvUwDGgXeoOUQtl_bRHuVdISrfOdlSaq350KN8Vm-XoQ-Ke3Ic63KDsdx3bnGf-8gdmC_8-rbHKQwPMJvTSJkoZLGUOd4lBYORx2b_aQBKH6DlXhk3ZolKV6G0OaaJCQcNkPGCS1qx0EgR03WUIiKVEeL8t2n7ZvR19DfRYgzr5ZMFNxgcjWopAiOe95EwBm4XE-To2CaUILCVZ5LU-Nt785LOsui4yWp-0_Vqfa_y2JdHqMWtzFFMv9r_fY83QuYCiGyj5OT6KDzmzTzJIAu9vYn6nITzWk_tnvD2E2Vn3FgpZQcswNfl8lq1OFrDT5MQwGi_kgY-nU1M-0lRW9O8-kYrSprE5zpchHHHVjrg%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

Hi there, By now you've probably heard a bit about what's on the line in this election. Our district is one of the most important battlegrounds in the nation, and it's one of the top targets for the national GOP and their dark money allies. **The tremendous national implications of this race aren't lost on me. But at the end of the day, that's not why I'm running. I'm running because this is my home too.** I have lived in this district, in the same house, for most of my life. My parents didn't have a college education, and they never had much money. But they made a good life for us here, the same way so many Ohioans did: with hard work, perseverance, and the support of their community. It's the honor of my life to represent my home community in Congress, friend. My constituents are my friends and my neighbors. I go to work for them every day in Washington with the same fire I had when I was first elected. **Because here's the truth:_the Heartland has been overlooked and underserved for too long._** That's why I'm fighting for real, transformative investments in communities like ours — investments that create good-paying jobs, protect our Great Lakes environment, and deliver a better future for working people everywhere. **[I'm so grateful to have you with me in that fight, friend. subject: In Congress, I’ll always vote to protect our nation's teachers and our children
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
**Happy Teacher Appreciation Week, Peter!**

I want to express my deepest gratitude to all educators, _especially those right here in St. Louis._

Our teachers tirelessly dedicate themselves both inside and outside the classroom to shaping the minds and futures of our nation's youth, despite the never-ending obstacles thrown their way.

Extreme legislators in Congress are seemingly hell-bent on undermining and attacking our teachers and education system, cutting funding, and pushing archaic book bans.

America’s teachers are consistently undervalued, underpaid, and overworked. And relentless attacks from groups like Moms for Liberty, are actively making their jobs harder with their dangerous agenda. _But let me make one thing clear:_ **As someone who believes in the value of education, Missouri's families and their students deserve better.**

Our educators deserve to be paid a livable wage, and our students deserve an education rooted in facts, free of extremist political interference.

That’s why, in Congress, I’ll always fight to ensure our children have access to a quality education that will help them succeed.

I'll never stop fighting to make investments that support our public schools right here in St. Louis, and across our state. Extreme legislators in Congress are seemingly hell-bent on undermining and attacking our teachers and education system, cutting funding, and pushing archaic book bans. America’s teachers are consistently undervalued, underpaid, and overworked. And relentless attacks from groups like Moms for Liberty, are actively making their jobs harder with their dangerous agenda. But let me make one thing clear: As someone who believes in the value of education, Missouri's families and their students deserve better. Our educators deserve to be paid a livable wage, and our students deserve an education rooted in facts, free of extremist political interference. # FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Reader, In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

**In today's media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong.** Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

**The New York Sun is different.** It's a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I've been impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

**The Sun's success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth.** But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don't wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Hey Peter! It’s Dalia, Pramila’s Organizing and Outreach Director!
Last weekend, Pramila and Susheela joined dozens of volunteers and community leaders for a day of action and canvassing to get out the vote for Susheela (we have pictures 📸)!
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240508.e-dvDr&refcode=em20240508-3853&t=2&akid=3853%2E420207%2EsX0q71)
**Thanks to your support, we had all the resources we needed to knock more doors and dig deep to organize communities that are too often ignored._Thank you!_ But our work isn’t done yet, Peter. **
[**Chip in today to fund our canvassing and organizing so we can continue to support Democrats up and down the ballot with our GOTV resources and collective power!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240508.e-dvDr&refcode=em20240508-3853&t=3&akid=3853%2E420207%2EsX0q71)
Our movement ran deep, with volunteers who traveled from all across Oregon and Washington to support Susheela’s campaign by knocking doors, connecting with voters, and sharing our progressive platform (more pictures below 📸).
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240508.e-dvDr&refcode=em20240508-3853&t=4&akid=3853%2E420207%2EsX0q71)

With the primaries well underway, we need to be able to seize any moment to grow our support[**—can we count on _your_ support today by chipping in to support our organizing and GOTV strategies?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240508.e-dvDr&refcode=em20240508-3853&t=5&akid=3853%2E420207%2EsX0q71)

body:
[1]Powered By People

In 2020, there were 2.7 million registered, likely Democrats in Texas who
didn’t turn out to vote. It was a reminder that we’ll all have to get more
creative when it comes to encouraging registered voters to get out and
cast a ballot.

That’s why our volunteers are establishing one-on-one relationships with
every voter they meet out in the field. After they register a new voter,
they’ll keep in touch with them throughout the election year to help
ensure they turn out in November.

They’ll help these Texans navigate our state’s voter suppression laws,
ensure they know where their closest polling place is, and give them the
nudge they may need to stay turned in, engage their friends and family,
and make it to the polls when they open.

train more volunteers to carry out this work?

Studies show that one-on-one relationships between a volunteer and a new
voter is key to boosting turnout. Voters will be much more responsive to
someone they’ve personally met than to an impersonal text or email from a
campaign or organization.

While this is the kind of innovation that’s necessary to win elections in
Texas, it’s going to require a significant investment in volunteer
recruitment and training. But I’m confident that with your help, we’ll be

So thank you for investing in the work that can make a difference.

| Peter,[**Tomorrow, May 9th at 6pm ET, Joe will be holding a virtual Big Ideas Discussion addressing Campus Due Process and the recent unrest we have seen across the country.**
](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=663bf7ea0cfc4d5737574d2a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbit.ly%2F5824jc4nj&w=65a6a2fba85b39036d9f5042&c=b_663ba2690bc93a041291756d&l=en-US&s=UTpiQtUbmfsnZ4q9qXeqou5Gvq8%3D)
As seasoned civil rights and free speech attorney, Joe is uniquely qualified to discuss this topic. He spent the last 12 years defending free speech on college campuses across the country - In fact, Joe is the principal author of almost all of the state laws in the country on campus free speech.[**
**](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=663bf7ea0cfc4d5737574d2a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbit.ly%2F5824jc4nj&w=65a6a2fba85b39036d9f5042&c=b_663ba2690bc93a041291756d&l=en-US&s=UTpiQtUbmfsnZ4q9qXeqou5Gvq8%3D)

---|---|---

He will lay out some concrete steps we can take to make campuses better places for all students. And we promise to avoid as much legalese as possible![**Your voice is vital to the conversation, Peter. Don’t miss it.**](https://mgcp02.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=663bf7ea0cfc4d5737574d2a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbit.ly%2F5824jc4nj&w=65a6a2fba85b39036d9f5042&c=b_663ba2690bc93a041291756d&l=en-US&s=UTpiQtUbmfsnZ4q9qXeqou5Gvq8%3D)

body:
#
Hi Derek, it's Jon Tester, Sherrod Brown, Bob Casey, and Tammy Baldwin.
Today, we’re reaching out with an important request: [**Can you split a donation between our campaigns and John Fetterman's to help us defend our Senate seats and fend off our right-wing, self-funding opponents? We’ll explain more in just a moment.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240508?refcode=em20240508&amount=5&refcode2=8988_434096_SDfbzM&akid=8988%2E434096%2ESDfbzM)

Election experts agree that Montana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin could determine control of the Senate this year.
That means if any one of us loses this November, it’s almost guaranteed that the GOP will reclaim the Senate majority and enable Republicans to enact their dangerous far-right agenda. **We can’t let that happen.**
Protecting our seats won’t be easy. Each of us are running against mega-millionaire opponents Mitch McConnell personally handpicked to unseat us, and dark money groups are dumping hundreds of millions of dollars into our races to attack our campaigns.
All four of us are facing our toughest reelection fight yet. We’ll need all hands on deck to help us fight back against right-wing attacks, defeat our mega-millionaire opponents, and keep the Senate majority out of the hands of the GOP.
[**Will you split a donation between our four campaigns and John Fetterman's to help defend our Senate seats and protect our razor-thin majority?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240508?refcode=em20240508&amount=5&refcode2=8988_434096_SDfbzM&akid=8988%2E434096%2ESDfbzM)

— Jon Tester, Sherrod Brown, Bob Casey, and Tammy Baldwin
