name: Michaela Kurinsky-Malos
subject: What your $5 will immediately help fund
body:
Here’s why I’m reaching out:
#
Hi, it’s Michaela — Sarah’s Campaign Manager!
I just wrapped up a meeting with Sarah and our team to review our financials and spending plans over the next few weeks.
As campaign manager, it’s my job to ensure we have the funds and strategy Sarah needs to win this historic campaign for Congress. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today!
**We’re now four months away from Sarah’s primary election, which means we need to kick our campaign into high gear.**
[**Can you pitch in $5 to help us expand our grassroots campaign? With your help, we can prove small states can do big things!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240508?refcode=em20240508-1-327&amount=5&refcode2=327_21716_s_-8XQ&akid=327%2E21716%2Es_-8XQ)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240508?amount=5&refcode=em20240508-1-327&refcode2=327_21716_s_-8XQ&akid=327%2E21716%2Es_-8XQ)**
**If you chip in $5 today, this is what your donation will immediately help fund:**
* Hiring a field organizer to mobilize volunteers, make phone calls, and knock on doors
* Opening a field office and supplying it with campaign literature, clipboards, pens, stickers, and yard signs
* Official campaign merch so voters can proudly show their support for Sarah everywhere they go
* In-person events to build the strong coalition Sarah needs to win an at-large seat in Congress
* TV and digital ads to educate Delaware voters about Sarah’s record and her plan to fight for workers and families in Washington

As one of Sarah’s top supporters, you know that she’s the real deal. Sarah is a proven changemaker — she’s been a powerhouse in the Delaware State Senate, and she’s ready to get to work in Washington.
**But we need to continue to run a robust campaign to ensure she gets there! That’s why I’m asking:**
[**Can you pitch in $5 or anything you can to help us ramp up our campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240508?refcode=em20240508-1-327&amount=5&refcode2=327_21716_s_-8XQ&akid=327%2E21716%2Es_-8XQ)

Thank you so much!
Michaela Kurinsky-Malos
Campaign Manager
Sarah McBride for Congress

Hi Peter,

This week we celebrated National Teacher Day, a day for honoring teachers and the enduring contributions they make every day. subject: It’s time to expand the Supreme Court.

#
Team, the Supreme Court is fundamentally broken right now. It’s time we expand the Supreme Court — here’s why: **In our democracy, the Court is not supposed to be a bastion of partisan interests and biased Justices.** However, Donald Trump vastly abused his presidential powers to appoint three right-wing justices to the Court, leaving behind a harmful legacy that outlives his presidency. The number of seats on the Supreme Court has changed several times before, and it needs to change again. **[If you agree, add your name in support of the _Judiciary Act_ , legislation that would help right Donald Trump’s wrongs and restore the balance of the Supreme Court. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84588561/471985066/-1119666580?refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240508_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODRiZmMzMy04YzBkLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Q8ksbATP3Zq_pnmCpsQXsKBGJUsCExKIFXwtGEpo98=&emci=474bfc33-8c0d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=484bfc33-8c0d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=6227932)** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84588562/471985067/-1119666580?refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240508_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODRiZmMzMy04YzBkLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Q8ksbATP3Zq_pnmCpsQXsKBGJUsCExKIFXwtGEpo98=&emci=474bfc33-8c0d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=484bfc33-8c0d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=6227932)
---
The impacts of Donald Trump’s appointments are devastating — on multiple fronts.
First, we’ve seen the courts overturn decades-long precedents, including the right to an abortion. I don’t need to explain how damaging the _Dobbs_ decision was.
The Supreme Court also delayed taking a case on whether Trump should have “absolute immunity.” The longer they delay, the more likely that Donald Trump could make it back to the White House, pardon himself, and dismantle the Justice Department from within. **It’s bad.**
Folks, the majority of Americans have an unfavorable view of the Supreme Court, according to recent polls. The Supreme Court should be an impartial, trustworthy institution to protect our democracy — but it’s become a breeding ground for controversial decisions that move our country back in time.
**[We need to take action before it’s too late. Sign your name to join me in support of the _Judiciary Act_ to expand the number of Supreme Court justices from 9 to 13. It’s the only way we will restore balance to the Court.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84588563/471985068/-1119666580?refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240508_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ODRiZmMzMy04YzBkLWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8Q8ksbATP3Zq_pnmCpsQXsKBGJUsCExKIFXwtGEpo98=&emci=474bfc33-8c0d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=484bfc33-8c0d-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=6227932)**

Friend,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kMuOozAQRb_G7ECmbB69YJEOZhLNY0G6I_UKOXY5WIMTxjbT4u9HRJne3jq6dXSlmydr1oZUrwRgtDoQAMJ2BGCJ7Czf33_6Ne3_8PRbcYbrdoQ9AYjrjF_ksyRDJ-20pVWb6IaDzI1KsMmrvICc1hVNxkaC1nUN9QWLlyLXUqpalmVZ5YXR_EViYhugwGlBa2BQ8TJjFVVUmaJm3BTmwgmnj0eZ8YhxtLff6LW005qpu0umZoxxDg-xjkAXUC0es09786g3gkAXrUvDiDiuqbn71EUCnZy9ndIglbfGKkxDlP6S-q2EdUER1v7XGk4HIQ4fgxDD6W3Xvw6n3b4_dse9GHpxHrpeiLfD8dd30be7448PAuUS3RDui1dIWOvx7zNyqO3iCGufuz1CJd0s7fVGWPsl8zxF9Bttos4T3-j5006TDWVFOL0-BlF39y8AAP__7J6Q3A)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kMuOozAQRb_G7ECmbB69YJEOZhLNY0G6I_UKOXY5WIMTxjbT4u9HRJne3jq6dXSlmydr1oZUrwRgtDoQAMJ2BGCJ7Czf33_6Ne3_8PRbcYbrdoQ9AYjrjF_ksyRDJ-20pVWb6IaDzI1KsMmrvICc1hVNxkaC1nUN9QWLlyLXUqpalmVZ5YXR_EViYhugwGlBa2BQ8TJjFVVUmaJm3BTmwgmnj0eZ8YhxtLff6LW005qpu0umZoxxDg-xjkAXUC0es09786g3gkAXrUvDiDiuqbn71EUCnZy9ndIglbfGKkxDlP6S-q2EdUER1v7XGk4HIQ4fgxDD6W3Xvw6n3b4_dse9GHpxHrpeiLfD8dd30be7448PAuUS3RDui1dIWOvx7zNyqO3iCGufuz1CJd0s7fVGWPsl8zxF9Bttos4T3-j5006TDWVFOL0-BlF39y8AAP__7J6Q3A)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8kMFuozAQhp9muIHM2GD2wCFdzCbSpiulaaSeEDFDsBYDa5tWvP0qUdvb6JtfM5_-1i6j6bcS5BMgDqbzgAh8B4hr4Jf29fXotvj0T8S_sgve7kv8CYhhW-g7-XkkIdua8U5lFXWlwDbtdURlKtMMU1ZIFg0ly6gThejxh5RpxrhkV4lSaI19dqWCR6ZEhoJlrECOUuQJl0wz3WcFF33WXwUI9niU9I4oDGb6S65rzbglerbRWA4hLP4hVgPWnvTqKPkwk6PungCsg7GxH4iGLe5nF9sAWE_zO9krufidArl28nHXbvEAvPamA14dzgowt48ZMPcaeIUMeZqmrHnZK7V_a1RzOKvm-c9FHZ_Uqbmoszrtnl_iavfW7OtmXwPma7CNn1enCXj1TSx1ZrXAK3XcHX5_Qt3apTW3CXj1JRW5sls-zDgan0sQ7PYoQs_2fwAAAP__vGWLsQ)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

Friends,
Bob Lorinser's opponent recently attempted to remove him from the ballot [https://www.votedrbob.com/post/lorinser-campaign-responds-to-callie-barr-s-irresponsible-legal-challenge-to-petitions] , resorting to underhanded tactics to disenfranchise voters and challenge the validity of his nomination signatures.
The legal opinions are unanimous - this blatant disregard for fair play has absolutely no merit and is nothing more than dirty politics at its worst.
When it goes to the Board of Canvassers at the end of May, the challenge will be thrown out. In the meantime, attending to this matter has cost us resources — time, energy, and legal fees.
This was Bob's opponent's desperate attempt to slow us down, halt our fundraising efforts, and throw us off our game. We won't allow it. In fact, with your support, this will embolden us.
Friends, can you please help replenish our efforts?
STAND UP TO DIRTY POLITICS [drbob.me/aboutbob]
With you—and the law—in Bob's corner, nothing will break our stride, not even this Trump-style tactic to interfere with Democracy.
While this frivolous challenge lacks legal ground, its underlying intent remains concerning.
It seeks to sow doubt among voters and disrupt our campaign momentum. But let me be clear: Bob Lorinser will be on the ballot, and we are poised for a significant victory in the August primary.
Together, we are running a positive, forward-thinking campaign that resonates with voters across our district. Our momentum remains strong, and we're deeply grateful for your belief in our cause.
Being the Democratic front-runner doesn't come without obstacles. Sadly, this is one of them, but we have a slam dunk against the challenge, and this has only energized Bob, not demoralized him.
We must continue our momentum, and your belief in our cause keeps us going. Thank you for contributing to help us replenish our efforts.
Onward!

# Addressing Antisemitism
---
**Here is the disturbing reality:** many people have used the violence in Gaza to increase hate and discrimination against Jewish people. What is not being covered is the irony that many of these people spewing antisemitism are the same people spewing Islamophobia, xenophobia, and other forms of hatred to anyone perceived as "different." Whether it's Islamophobia, antisemitism, or just plain hatred, it's all part of the same public toxicity that is becoming more widespread every day. What needs to be covered is that **the real members of this peace movement** will always **stand against hate.** This movement is a diverse coalition of individuals from all walks of life—Jews, Christians, Muslims, and many others—who refuse to tolerate bigotry and discrimination in every form. This is a peace movement that **will not allow outside agitators to break the bond** that has been formed between these diverse groups of people. So, while there may be forces out there intent on sowing discord and spreading hate, we refuse to yield an inch. It's crucial that this movement remains steadfast in our commitment to calling out terrorist organizations, terrorist states, and genocide, regardless of the challenges we may face. We will not shy away from confronting these atrocities head-on, and we will continue to **advocate for peace and justice on all fronts.** Together, we are stronger than hate. Together, we will overcome adversity. Together, we will build a world where tolerance and understanding prevail.

subject: BREAKING: A step forward
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Demanding better.
#
Recent studies show that nearly 89% of Americans support legalizing cannabis.1
Despite growing support and full legalization in certain areas, cannabis charges bar many Americans — disproportionately people of color, **who are nearly 4 times more likely to be arrested for marijuana** — from housing opportunities, employment, and more.
Since her first day on the campaign trail, Alexandria has stood with community leaders and organizers to advocate for expungement of low-level cannabis offenses, and pushed lawmakers to support legislation that centers racial justice.
Which is why this news is a _huge_ victory for our movement:
This shift would mean marijuana is no longer grouped alongside highly dangerous drugs like heroin, and opens the door to softening restrictions at state and local levels.
**This is a major victory for our movement. But there’s a lot more to be done.**
[Ideas like decriminalizing marijuana are called ‘unrealistic,’ but we can win a better world by continuing to build coalitions and demanding change. Will you donate $5 right now to support Alexandria’s campaign for real progress? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240508._4AJSq&refcode=em20240508-6367-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6367%2E2526796%2EExmYHc)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240508._4AJSq&refcode=em20240508-6367-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=6367%2E2526796%2EExmYHc)**
We need to get Alexandria back to Congress so she can keep doing what she was elected to do: **demand better**.
Whether or not you can contribute today, thank you for being part of this movement.
Thank you,
Team AOC
1 - [**Pew Research Center** : Americans overwhelmingly say marijuana should be legal for medical or recreational use](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/26015?t=21&akid=6367%2E2526796%2EExmYHc)
